name: Acus TECHNOLOGIES Co., Ltd.
summary: 易恬技术是一家ToF传感器研发生产商,专注单线/多线和单点/多点固态激光雷达研发,应用领域主要针对AGV、智能机器人室内导航、深度点云体感交互和中小学STEAM教育智能硬件。

name: AgiBot
summary:
AgiBot develops embodied AI systems that combine robot hardware, intelligent control and tools for collecting and training on physical-world data. Its portfolio includes the Yuan Zheng A-series humanoids, Lingxi X-series platforms and Genie G-series robots, together with dexterous hands, teleoperation equipment and robot-management software.

The company organizes its technology around locomotion, human interaction and practical manipulation.

name: AGILE ROBOTS
name_zh: 北京思灵机器人科技有限责任公司
summary: Develops intelligent robots and dexterous manipulation technologies.

name: AgileTact
name_zh: 深圳聚触灵动技术有限公司
summary: AgileTact is a Shenzhen-based developer of tactile sensors and data-capture hardware for robots, grippers and dexterous hands. Its sensor portfolio covers single-point three-axis force sensing, distributed tactile arrays, whole-fingertip sensing and integrated fingertip/finger-pad devices. The official company introduction identifies Hong Kong-based AgileReach as its parent company.

name: AGILINK
name_zh: 上海临界点创新智能科技有限公司
summary: Develops robotic hands, grippers and dexterous manipulation solutions. The business was spun out of AGIBOT and operates as a separate company.

name: AI-LINK Network Co.,LTD.
name_zh: 深圳艾灵网络有限公司
summary: 人工智能科技、网络科技、云计算科技、数据科技、通讯科技领域内技术开发、技术推广、技术转让、技术咨询、技术服务;基础软件服务;应用软件的技术服务;经营进出口业务;传输设备、数据通信设备、计算机系统集成;智能网络控制系统设备的设计及上门安装;安全防范设备的上门安装与上门维护;计算机网络服务;通信综合集成系统网络的设计、技术开发、上门安装;通信交换设备、终端设备的销售;物联网通信产品的研发、销售。(以上根据法律、行政法规、国务院决定等规定需要审批的,依法取得相关审批文件后方可经营) 安防产品、无线数据产品(不含限制项目)的研发、生产、销售;网络系统工程的设计与安装;互联网信息服务;安防产品、无线数据产品(不含限制项目)的生产;物联网通信产品的生产。

name: AI² Robotics
summary:
AI² Robotics (Zhipingfang) develops general-purpose intelligent robots around its AlphaBot hardware and AlphaBrain embodied AI platform. Founded in April 2023, the company combines model development with robot design, manufacturing, data collection and deployment.

AlphaBrain connects environmental understanding, whole-body coordination and multi-step task planning. The company provides industrial solutions for handling, loading, assembly and equipment operation, as well as commercial interaction and drink preparation.

name: Anyverse Dynamics
summary: Anyverse Dynamics is a Beijing company developing embodied AI and its own robot hardware. Its approach combines world models and reinforcement learning with a mobile-manipulation platform for industrial and commercial tasks. Its manufacturer materials identify K15 as a second-generation self-developed robot and describe the MWA embodied-intelligence system. The company operates under the Chinese name Wujie Dongli.

name: APLUX
summary: APLUX is a Chengdu-based developer of edge AI software and robotic systems. Its fusion operating system and AI deployment tools support intelligent robots, industrial inspection and edge computing. APLUX co-developed and released the Ultra Magnus humanoid prototype with Ti5 Robot and Qualcomm technology: APLUX supplies the operating system and edge AI integration, while Ti5 contributes joint modules and motion-control algorithms.

name: ARTROBOT
name_zh: 北京钢铁侠科技有限公司
summary:
ARTROBOT, operated by Beijing Gangtiexia Technology, develops humanoid, wheeled and other legged robots together with motion-control technology. Founded in September 2015, the company combines complete robot design with internally developed components and algorithms. Its humanoid platforms include the ART series, and its engineering work also covers gait controllers and robot joints.

The company serves university laboratories, research and teaching, specialized robotics and energy-safety applications.

name: Astribot
summary:
Astribot (Xingchen Intelligence) was founded in Shenzhen in late 2022. Our vision is for billions of people to have AI robot assistants, and our mission is to promote human–robot coexistence, co-creation and shared success.
The company pioneered an integrated hardware and software architecture called Design for AI (DFAI), closely combining AI intelligence with advanced manipulation.

name: Atom Robotics
name_zh: 天津辰星技术股份有限公司
summary: Tianjin Chenxing Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2013. It is a nationally recognized high-tech enterprise, a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise, and a leading domestic brand in high-speed industrial robotics.

name: AutoLife Robotics
summary: AutoLife Robotics develops humanoid robots for retail, reception, dining and other indoor service work. The brand began in Singapore in 2023 and operates in China through Guangdong AutoLife Technology, with offices in Guangzhou and Shenzhen. Its work combines robot hardware, navigation, perception and manipulation with application design, field deployment and support.

name: Beijing Fanuc Electromechanical Co., Ltd. Shenzhen Branch
name_zh: 北京发那科机电有限公司深圳分公司
summary: 一般经营项目是:销售本公司生产的发那科数控系统、交流伺服电机、交流伺服单元、交流主轴电机、交流主轴单元、GE、FANUC可编程控制器、CNC交钥匙系统产品、发那科激光发生器、发那科机器人及机器人机械的售后服务。,许可经营项目是:

name: Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center
name_zh: 北京人形机器人创新中心
summary:
Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center develops complete embodied-intelligence systems, combining humanoid hardware, control models, data services and testing infrastructure. Established in November 2023, its core platforms include the Tien Kung robot family and HuiSi KaiWu, a general-purpose embodied intelligence platform intended to support multiple tasks and robot types.

Its public applications include exhibition guidance, industrial-part sorting, equipment inspection and autonomous handling.

name: Booster Robotics
summary:
Booster Robotics develops humanoid robots and supporting software for researchers, educators and developers. Founded in 2023, it initially focused on scientific research and education, bringing together robot hardware, operating systems and development tools. Its product portfolio includes the T-series platforms and K1, with robot football and other competitions serving as demanding environments for testing control and autonomy.

The company emphasizes whole-body motion, balance and accessible development workflows.

name: BrainCo
summary: Develops brain-computer interfaces and bionic hands.

name: BXI Robotics
summary: BXI Robotics, known in Chinese as Banxing Technology, is a humanoid robot and actuator manufacturer founded in Huangpu, Shanghai. It develops the Elf humanoid series, hollow-shaft planetary joint motors, robot control modules and a dual-arm teleoperation platform. Its Shanghai team handles research and development, with machining and assembly in Shenzhen. The company also offers OEM and ODM programs covering robot design, component selection and system integration.

name: BYD
summary:
BYD is a diversified technology and manufacturing group with businesses in automobiles, electronics, new energy and rail transit. Established in Shenzhen in 1994, it began with rechargeable batteries and expanded into electric vehicles and related systems. Its vehicle portfolio includes BYD, Denza, Fangchengbao and Yangwang.

A defining feature of the company is vertical integration: it develops batteries, motors and electronic controls alongside key materials and complete products. This connects component development with manufacturing and after-sales services across its operations.

name: CACZ
name_zh: 深圳常安创智科技有限公司
summary: CACZ is a Shenzhen developer of robot-joint motor drives and specialized electric drives, power modules and sensors. Its robotics portfolio comprises compact, high-power compact, hollow and high-power hollow joint drivers. The company offers custom development for robotics and AGV applications and separately supplies high-temperature equipment for demanding industrial environments.

name: CASBOT
summary:
CASBOT, also known as Zhongke Huiling, develops general-purpose humanoid robots and embodied-intelligence products for practical applications. Founded in 2023, its portfolio includes the CASBOT 01 and CASBOT 02 full-size bipedal robots, the CASBOT W1 wheeled platform and the Handle-L1 dexterous hand.

The company works across robot hardware, manipulation and application development, with an emphasis on moving systems beyond stage demonstrations into usable operating scenarios.

name: CasiVision
summary:
CasiVision develops machine-vision and intelligent-inspection technology for industrial production. Its portfolio combines optical imaging, automated analysis and electromechanical equipment, organized around the ideas of a 'smart eye,' 'smart brain' and 'smart hand.' The company supplies both enabling technology and integrated inspection systems.

Application areas described on its site include semiconductors, new-energy manufacturing, furniture panels and textiles. Its work spans how an image is acquired, how defects or features are recognized, and how a machine acts on the result.

name: CETC
summary:
China Electronics Technology Group Corporation, known as CETC, is an electronics and information-technology group whose robotics activities span complete machines and core components. Its embodied-intelligence work draws on capabilities in sensing, communication, control and system integration.

At the 2026 World Robot Conference, CETC presented the Exploration D1 humanoid, Baihong Exploration exoskeleton, wheeled-legged robots and electric joints. Its demonstrations connected environmental perception with interaction and physical execution.

name: ChangingTek
name_zh: 知行机器人科技（苏州）有限公司
summary: Develops robotic hands and end effectors.

name: Changyuan Medical Precision (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 长园医疗精密(深圳)有限公司
summary:
长园医疗精密(深圳)有限公司成立于2000年4月5日,法定代表人郑立新,位于广东省深圳市南山区。公司专注于电子技术开发、电子产品生产和类医疗器械生产领域,拥有多项专利技术,包括托盘上料推车、顶升压合机构等实用型发明,并开发了万用表测量系统、端对端管理系统等软件产品。企业通过技术创新在精密制造领域形成专业生产能力。
长园医疗精密(深圳)有限公司获评2024年国家级高新技术企业、2023年省级专精特新中小企业和2023年省级创新型中小企业。该公司在医疗器械自动化设备领域取得医疗器械质量管理体系认证,通过技术创新在精密制造领域形成专业生产能力。作为医疗器械制造整体解决方案提供商,该公司在医疗健康领域各层级均有自主研发产品,专利和软件著作权数量超过80件,并选择糖尿病治疗设备作为重点发展领域。
以上内容由AI生成,仅供参考,请注意甄别。

name: Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center
name_zh: 成都人形机器人创新中心
summary: Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center, or CHRIC, is a Chengdu robotics company and research commercialization center. It develops complete humanoid platforms, robot control and decision systems, and sensing technologies. Its own product range includes TangPa, Gongga and Jinbao robots, with applications in public interaction, cultural tourism and embodied intelligence development.

name: Chengdu Sharp Sensing
name_zh: 成都锐觉传感技术有限公司
summary: Chengdu Sharp Sensing develops biomimetic electronic skin and flexible tactile sensors for robots. Its robotics portfolio includes fingertip and industrial gripper sensors and an electronic-skin module for companion robots and interactive toys.

name: Chengdu Ximengelin Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 成都西蒙格林数字科技有限公司
summary: 研发触觉传感及灵巧手方案。

name: Chengqing Robotics
summary: Chengqing Robotics is a Shanghai company developing humanoid robots for learning and companionship. Its DaCheng brand combines a small articulated robot body with voice interaction and app control for educational use. The company describes work on multimodal interaction, humanoid mechanical structures and education applications, and lists an operating office in Shanghai’s Huangpu District.

name: Chip Computing Unlimited (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: 芯算无限是一家智能陪伴情绪情感机器人研发商,芯算无限在情感识别和分析技术的基础上,推出了情绪AI芯片,将情感计算能力与芯片计算设备有机结合,帮助机器人正确理解、感知、识别人的情感和意图,并做出合适反应和反馈。芯算无限的情绪AI芯片应用于机器人,为机器人加载情感大脑,机器人能够根据人的情感需求做出适当的交互反馈。

name: CHOHO
name_zh: 青岛征和工业股份有限公司
summary: Develops chain transmission technology and chain-driven dexterous hands through its robotics business.

name: Cowa Robot
summary:
Cowa, also known as COWAROBOT, develops Physical AI systems for urban services. Its portfolio spans city-operation service robots, quadrupeds, autonomous shuttle vehicles and humanoid robots, using different physical forms to address different tasks. The company's public materials describe a broader 'Robo-City' approach to bringing robots into everyday urban operations.

Its emphasis is on automating repetitive or strenuous activities while improving consistency and safety in service delivery.

name: CRP Robot
name_zh: 成都卡诺普机器人技术股份有限公司
summary: CRP Robot is a Chengdu-based Chinese manufacturer of industrial robots, collaborative robots and embodied-intelligence systems. Founded in 2012, the company develops robot controllers, core components and complete robots for manufacturing. Its humanoid portfolio includes wheeled robots designed to combine mobile navigation with two-arm industrial manipulation.

name: Cyan Robotics
summary:
Cyan Robotics (Qingxin Yichuang) develops embodied character robots that combine physical movement with expressive, personality-driven interaction. Its products include Amoo, a compact companion robot with a soft exterior, and a larger humanoid platform. The company also develops DinoOS, a foundation for building and reusing robot character capabilities.

Its engineering combines navigation, vision, sound localization, tactile sensing and coordinated behavior.

name: Cyborg Robotics
summary:
Cyborg Robotics (Saiboge Robotics) develops embodied-intelligence systems for hazardous and physically demanding work. Its principal focus is on industries such as power generation, gas, petroleum, chemicals, coal and heavy manufacturing, where inspection and specialized operations can expose people to risk.

The company combines humanoid robotics with multimodal inspection equipment and learning-based task execution. Its business also covers general-purpose robotics, education and data collection, while specialized high-risk applications remain the central emphasis.

name: D-Robotics
summary:
D-Robotics provides computing hardware and software foundations for robot developers. Originating from Horizon Robotics, it supplies the Sunrise intelligent-computing chips and RDK development kits, together with a software platform and developer resources. Its role is to help teams build and deploy intelligent robots rather than focus on a single complete humanoid product.

The platforms support applications including humanoids, wheeled-legged robots, quadrupeds, service and companion robots, logistics AMRs, cleaning robots and lawn mowers.

name: Daimeng Robotics
summary:
Daimeng Robotics, also branded Daimon Robotics, develops tactile sensing and dexterous manipulation technology for embodied AI. The company grew from a Hong Kong University of Science and Technology research team, began operations in 2023 and has its headquarters in Shenzhen with research activity in Hong Kong.

Its products include high-resolution visual-tactile sensors, teleoperation systems with force or touch feedback, and tools for collecting multimodal manipulation data. The company combines vision, touch, language and action in its data and model development.

name: DAX Robotics
summary: DAX Robotics is a Beijing robotics developer focused on mobile manipulation for retail, logistics, pharmacy handling and other repetitive work. The company develops a robot platform and an embodied world model together, and offers its X7 platform in research and commercial configurations. Its official product portfolio also includes a heavy-load quadruped platform. The company presents robot hardware, local inference and application deployment as an integrated system.

name: Deep Innovation Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 深度创新科技(深圳)有限公司
summary: 仪器仪表制造;技术服务、技术开发、技术咨询、技术交流、技术转让、技术推广;工业设计服务;数据处理和存储支持服务;专业设计服务;人工智能行业应用系统集成服务;软件开发;工业控制计算机及系统制造;工业机器人制造;电子元器件制造;计算机软硬件及辅助设备零售;计算机软硬件及辅助设备批发;通用设备制造(不含特种设备制造);机械设备销售;通讯设备销售;软件销售;工业控制计算机及系统销售;工业机器人销售;电子产品销售;仪器仪表销售;人工智能硬件销售;货物进出口;技术进出口;进出口代理。(除依法须经批准的项目外,凭营业执照依法自主开展经营活动) 无

name: DEEP Robotics
summary:
DEEP Robotics develops quadruped robots, humanoid platforms and core robotic components for embodied-intelligence applications. Its product range includes industrial inspection quadrupeds, the DR humanoid series and joint modules, supported by perception, navigation and motion-control technology.

The company develops an integrated perception–decision–execution stack, combining environmental sensing with movement and task control. Its application areas include energy infrastructure, emergency response, industrial operations, research and education.

name: DEXFORCE
summary:
DexForce develops embodied-intelligence technology combining robot hardware, simulation, vision and learned control. Founded in 2021, its portfolio includes the DexVerse simulation engine, DexWorldModel world models, DexSense vision sensors and the DexForce W1 Pro humanoid robot.

The company uses simulation and real-world experience to develop robots capable of manipulation in changing environments. Its products connect data generation, perception, model training and physical execution, with applications across intelligent manufacturing and commercial services.

name: DexRobot
name_zh: 浙江灵巧智能科技有限公司
summary: Develops multimodal dexterous manipulation systems.

name: DH-Robotics Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: DH-ROBOTICS was founded in 2016. It is a high-tech company focused on providing core components for intelligent industrial manufacturing. Specializing in precision motion control, the company has filled a gap in China's precision actuator sector. Its portfolio includes more than 200 products across multiple series, including servo electric grippers, voice-coil actuators, servo electric cylinders, dexterous hands and the iFM intelligent flexible motion system.

name: Dianyun Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 点昀技术(深圳)有限公司
summary:
点昀技术(深圳)有限公司成立于2021年10月,法定代表人孙启霖,公司位于广东省深圳市南山区。企业专注于人工智能领域,主要提供人工智能行业应用系统集成服务、人工智能基础资源与技术平台以及人工智能公共数据平台。公司在技术研发方面拥有多项专利和软件著作权,涉及过电压保护电路、视镜显示图像处理、相机校正方法以及车载摄像头等领域,并开发了电容测试软件、EVT2测试软件、数据分发软件等专用工具。
点昀技术(深圳)有限公司在2024年获得AIoT新维奖·新锐榜,2025年入选国家级科技型中小企业。该公司入驻龙华数字智造中心(建泰项目),获得政策支持,体现了其在人工智能领域的认可度。
以上内容由AI生成,仅供参考,请注意甄别。

name: Dierberg (Shenzhen) Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: 帝尔博格是一家重工智能机器人研发商,立足重型工业智能制造领域,致力于数据“自感知、自决策、自验证、自学习、自适应”,围绕智能化设备级、系统级、产线级维度,打造柔性、多机协同制造的工作业态,为重工业数字化、智能化、无人化赋能。 公司聚焦于工业智能化软硬件设计,开发了根植于行业特性的控制系统、视觉算法、多模态感知系统、数据优化算法等及数据中台,具备行业领先的中大型重工场景智能化解决方案设计、标品设计及专业技术能力。

name: Digit Robotics
summary: Digit Robotics is dedicated to large-scale commercial deployment of AGI robots. It focuses on multimodal interactive foundation-model algorithms and intelligent hardware for humanoid robots, covering the full process from design, research and development to production and commercial application. Its products include general-purpose humanoid robots for interactive services, lifelike humanoid robots, character-IP robots and embodied intelligent interaction platforms.

name: DOBOT
summary:
DOBOT (Yuejiang) develops collaborative robots, desktop robot arms and embodied-intelligence platforms. Its engineering includes integrated drive-and-control technology, robot motion control and safety systems. The portfolio serves industrial production, education and commercial automation, connecting compact robot products with larger manufacturing solutions.

The company has expanded into humanoid and consumer robotics alongside its established arm business. Its international operations support customers through product development, application integration and services.

name: DZZ Robotics
summary: DZZ Robotics is a Xi’an developer of educational robots, consumer service robotics and robot motion joints. Its own product portfolio includes the SIGMA family of desktop humanoids and other legged educational platforms. The company provides hardware and teaching resources for schools, universities and robotics training, with emphasis on robot structures, control and hands-on experimentation.

name: EIR Technology
name_zh: 四川具身人形机器人科技有限公司
summary:
EIR Technology, operated by Sichuan Embodied Humanoid Robotics Technology, develops humanoid robots for physical interaction and human-facing applications. Its public portfolio includes the full-size Skywalker I and Skywalker II robots, known in Chinese as Tianxingzhe, and AiQ (Aiqiu), a robot focused on emotional interaction.

The company combines complete robot development with an interest in making robots useful companions across different stages of life. Its customer resources include development documentation and robot service support.

name: Elephant Robotics
summary: Elephant Robotics is a Shenzhen robotics company founded in 2016. It develops and manufactures collaborative robot arms, mobile platforms, humanoid robots and robotic companion animals, alongside control software and education tools. Its Mercury humanoid family serves research, education and commercial development, complementing its myCobot, myArm and myAGV product lines.

name: ENCOS
name_zh: 南京因克斯智能科技有限公司
summary: Develops robot joints and dexterous hands.

name: EngineAI
summary:
EngineAI develops humanoid robots and related embodied-intelligence products, covering design, manufacturing and application deployment. Founded in October 2023 and headquartered in Shenzhen, it develops core components, robot bodies, motion-control algorithms and intelligent behavior as a connected technology stack.

Its platforms include PM01 and other humanoid products intended for research, education, industrial work and commercial services. Public demonstrations combine learning-based whole-body movement with interactive service and entertainment applications.

name: Ensuring Technology
summary: Ensuring Technology develops multidimensional tactile sensors, flexible electronic skin and wearable capture terminals for embodied intelligence. Its hardware measures contact and force and synchronizes tactile signals with hand motion for robot training and teleoperation.

name: Estun Automation
summary:
Estun Automation supplies industrial robots, automation software and integrated production solutions. Its portfolio includes general-purpose and specialized robots, collaborative robots, workstations and related equipment. The company also offers programming, simulation, vision and digital-factory tools, connecting robot hardware with the systems needed to operate an automated production process.

Applications include welding, adhesive dispensing, palletizing, polishing, press handling, bending and vision-guided picking.

name: FiguRobot
summary: FiguRobot is a Shanghai company developing desktop humanoid robots and companion AI hardware. It combines miniature articulated bodies with voice, expression and motion interaction, and offers software for personalizing robot characters and behavior. Its official product range includes the Nian NIA-FR02 desktop humanoid and related AI companion devices.

name: Flexiv
summary:
Flexiv develops adaptive robots that combine industrial force control, computer vision and AI. Founded in 2016 by a team with roots in Stanford robotics and artificial intelligence research, the company develops robot hardware and integrated solutions for customers across industries.

Its technical focus is on robots that can respond to contact and variations in the work environment, rather than depend exclusively on precisely repeated positioning. The business combines robot systems with application development and support, connecting manipulation technology with practical production tasks.

name: Fourier Intelligence
summary:
Fourier develops humanoid robots and rehabilitation robotics, connecting physical assistance with broader human–robot collaboration. Its humanoid portfolio includes the GRx bipedal family, the GR-3 series and GRW wheeled dual-arm robots. Alongside these platforms, it offers rehabilitation systems and integrated solutions for care and recovery settings.

The company supports an ecosystem of partners and developers through its Nexus network, technical resources and open-source activities.

name: FutureTakt
name_zh: 未来节拍智能科技（浙江）有限公司
summary: Develops five-finger robotic hands, collaborative arms and intelligent service and industrial robots.

name: Fuwei Intelligent
summary: Fuwei Intelligent is a Guangzhou developer of industrial robots and factory automation systems. Its portfolio includes humanoid robots, mobile manipulators, embodied intelligence controllers and flexible assembly systems. The company combines its GRID industrial model with robot control, visual perception and workflow tools for manufacturing tasks.

name: Galaxea Dynamics
summary:
Galaxea Dynamics develops embodied AI foundation models and robot platforms as a combined hardware-and-intelligence system. Founded in September 2023, the company serves technology companies, startups, universities and research laboratories working on manipulation, autonomy and physical-world learning.

Its customer work covers algorithm development, data collection and application deployment. The company draws on experience in bringing complex technology products and autonomous-driving systems into production, applying that background to robot development.

name: Gedian Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 革点科技(深圳)有限公司
summary: 一般经营项目:机电设备、光电产品、电子产品、仪器仪表、计算机软硬件、一类医疗器械的研发、销售;网络工程;自动化工程;软件工程;计算机系统集成;五金交电、光学器材、安防设备、电线电缆、金属材料、办公用品、工艺礼品(象牙及其制品除外)的销售;国内贸易;经营进出口业务。(以上法律、行政法规、国务院决定规定在登记前须经批准的项目除外,限制的项目须取得许可后方可经营)软件开发;技术服务、技术开发、技术咨询、技术交流、技术转让、技术推广;人工智能应用软件开发;人工智能理论与算法软件开发;信息系统集成服务;人工智能行业应用系统集成服务;智能机器人的研发;计算机系统服务;工艺美术品及礼仪用品销售(象牙及其制品除外);货物进出口;电子元器件零售;智能仪器仪表销售;光电子器件销售;人工智能硬件销售;电子测量仪器销售;智能机器人销售;工业机器人销售;信息技术咨询服务;网络与信息安全软件开发。(除依法须经批准的项目外,凭营业执照依法自主开展经营活动)许可经营项目:机电设备、光电产品、电子产品、仪器仪表、计算机软硬件、一类医疗器械的测试。(依法须经批准的项目,经相关部门批准后方可开展经营活动,具体经营项目以相关部门批准文件或许可证件为准)

name: Gemini
summary: Gemini is a Suzhou-based developer of humanoid robots for industrial applications. Known in Chinese as Shuangzi Zhiqing, the company was established in 2025 through Suzhou BEST and combines industrial motion control with an AI decision system. Its product portfolio includes the GeminiBot A1 wheeled humanoid, alongside robotic arms, core components and application systems. The company targets manufacturing tasks with a planned progression into commercial and household environments.

name: GENISOM AI
summary: GENISOM AI, also known as Zhishen Technology, develops embodied intelligence robots, motion control and integrated joint modules. Established in December 2023, the company operates in Beijing and Suzhou. Its product portfolio includes industrial quadrupeds and the Yin Yi NE01 humanoid. GENISOM combines in-house robot hardware, core components and software for research, inspection, emergency response and entertainment applications.

name: GigaAI
summary:
GigaAI develops embodied AI models, world-model tools and robot hardware as a connected system. Its Maker H01 platform combines a mobile base with two articulated arms, while GigaBrain provides decision-making and control and GigaWorld supports simulation and the generation of training data.

The company focuses on transferring learned capabilities across environments and robot configurations. Its development stack connects sensor inputs, task planning, motion planning and physical execution, with applications described in homes, commercial services, light industry and research.

name: GLroad Robotics
name_zh: 武汉格蓝若智能机器人有限公司
summary: GLroad Robotics is a Wuhan-based robot developer and manufacturer within the GLroad group. It works with Chen Xuedong's team at Huazhong University of Science and Technology on humanoid robot development and technology transfer. Its Laborer family targets physically demanding work and power-infrastructure inspection, with additional biped, quadruped and wheeled robot platforms under development.

name: GON
name_zh: 青岛国恩科技股份有限公司
summary: Develops advanced materials and embodied robotics hardware. Its tendon-driven five-finger hand has reached the physical-prototype stage.

name: Googol Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: 固高科技专注于运动控制、伺服驱动、多维感知、工业现场网络和工业软件五个方向的核心技术研究,通过深入的国内外合作、产学研相结合、积极培育系统集成商等创新的商业模式,将固高科技的运控技术及产品广泛应用于微电子、机器人、数控机床、电子加工、检测、印刷、包装及生产自动化等工业控制领域。

name: Guangdong Haoningda Industrial Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 广东浩宁达实业有限公司
summary:
广东浩宁达实业有限公司成立于2000年9月,法定代表人为周俊。公司总部位于深圳市南山区,在惠州市大亚湾经济技术开发区设有制造基地。作为一家专业从事电工仪器仪表和能源计量领域的企业,公司专注于产品研发、生产、销售及服务。
广东浩宁达实业有限公司在2025年获得国家级绿色工厂和国家级专精特新'小巨人'企业两项重要认定,同时入选省级工程技术研究中心。作为专业从事电工仪器仪表和能源计量领域的企业,广东浩宁达实业有限公司在广东省市场监督管理局2023年型式批准计量器具专项监督抽查中,其产品计量性能符合要求。
以上内容由AI生成,仅供参考,请注意甄别。

name: Guohua Intelligent
summary: Guohua Intelligent is a robotics manufacturer based in Qingdao, China. It develops and manufactures precision reducers, roller screws, joint modules, robot arms and complete humanoid robot platforms. Its own robot portfolio includes the wheeled Zhishu 2 and the bipedal Yunyi 2. The company also provides configurable robot hardware and ODM development services, covering design, assembly and validation for customers building embodied-intelligence systems.

name: Guoxing Huijin (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 国兴汇金(深圳)科技有限公司
summary:
国兴汇金(深圳)科技有限公司成立于2012年2月24日,法定代表人为徐帅。公司专注于分布式光纤传感器及相关技术的研发、生产与应用推广,在分布式光纤传感技术领域拥有多项核心专利与技术突破。企业主营业务包括分布式光纤温度传感器的研发和应用,尤其在油田开发领域通过高精度温度监测为油井复产提供技术支持。
国兴汇金(深圳)科技有限公司在2025年先后获得国家级高新技术企业、省级创新型中小企业和国家级科技型中小企业认定。作为专业从事分布式光纤实时监测技术的企业,该公司在2023年中国国际石油石化技术装备展览会上展示了其技术实力,拥有30余项知识产权证书,并在多个专业会议上发表技术应用成果论文。东营市政府考察团曾到访该公司,了解其分布式光纤生产检测技术,体现了地方政府对技术企业的关注。
以上内容由AI生成,仅供参考,请注意甄别。

name: GYENNO Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: 臻络科技是一家以帕金森及运动障碍类疾病为起点,针对神经病学领域自主研发,致力于构建基于智能康复机器人的精准远程医疗系统的初创公司,主打产品有GYENNO One智能腕带、防抖汤勺“睿餐”等。

name: Habo Intelligence (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
summary: 哈工大业是一家智慧城市及智能交通解决方案提供商,专注于智慧城市、智能交通解决方案与产品提供,目前已成熟应用的解决方案有:交通图像数据挖掘系统、高速公路防逃费系统、收费车道冲卡取证系统、激光式车型分析系统、路径二义性识别系统、货车治超系统、停车场反向寻车系统、黄标车限行系统等。

name: Haier
summary:
Haier develops home appliances, connected-home technology and robotic systems intended to coordinate with the household environment. Its smart-living work combines sensing, AI and appliance control so that products can respond to the context of daily activities. At AWE 2026, Haier presented home robots as an extension of this connected ecosystem.

The announced lineup included the Haiwa Cleaning Robot, intended to take a more active role in tidying living spaces. Haier also describes robotics activity in industrial settings, including embodied-robot trials through STEP.

name: HAMOOBot
name_zh: 北京航墨科技有限公司
summary: HAMOOBot, operated by Beijing Hangmo Technology, develops robot motion and force-control technologies. Its Flexmo joint modules combine gearing, a frameless torque motor, servo drive, elastic elements and absolute encoders for compliant robot actuation. The official portfolio specifies three Star-series and three Titan-series modules; the company also develops complete industrial and exoskeleton robots.

name: Han's Laser Technology Industry Group Co.,Ltd.
name_zh: 大族激光科技产业集团股份有限公司
summary: 一般经营项目:经营进出口业务;物业租赁。(法律、行政法规、国务院决定禁止的项目除外,限制的项目须取得许可后方可经营)许可经营项目:激光、机器人及自动化技术在智能制造领域的系统解决方案;激光雕刻机、激光焊接机、激光切割机、激光器及相关元件(不含限制项目)、机器人相关产品的研发、生产和销售;普通货运。

name: HandX Innovation
summary: HandX Innovation is a Wuhan developer of humanoid robots, dexterous hands and tactile sensing technology. The company’s products include the Yuanyou humanoid, moxibustion robots, assistive hands, and sensing devices. It combines robot perception and movement-control research with commercialization for everyday assistance and industrial support.

name: Hangzhou Haikang Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. Shenzhen Branch
name_zh: 杭州海康智能科技有限公司深圳分公司
summary: 杭州海康智能科技有限公司深圳分公司成立于2022-04-01,负责人为吴尧,统一社会信用代码为91440300MA5H98Y5X5,企业注册地址位于深圳市南山区粤海街道高新区社区科技南路16号深圳湾科技生态园11栋A1208,所属行业为批发业,经营范围包含:一般经营项目是:工业机器人销售;服务消费机器人销售;智能机器人销售;智能机器人的研发;工业控制计算机及系统销售;照相机及器材销售;光学仪器销售;物联网设备销售;通讯设备销售;通讯设备修理;计算机软硬件及辅助设备批发;特种设备销售;技术服务、技术开发、技术咨询、技术交流、技术转让、技术推广;软件开发;计算机系统服务;信息系统集成服务;人工智能行业应用系统集成服务;机械设备租赁;特种设备出租;工业机器人安装、维修;电子、机械设备维护(不含特种设备)。(除依法须经批准的项目外,凭营业执照依法自主开展经营活动),许可经营项目是:无。企业当前经营状态为存续。

name: HARIBIT
summary: HARIBIT is a Beijing robotics developer incubated from Beijing Institute of Technology. It develops and supplies robot systems, motion control technology and components such as motors, reducers and integrated joints. Its portfolio includes special-purpose humanoids, quadruped inspection robots and mobile manipulation platforms. The company targets demanding field environments as well as research, industrial and service applications.

name: HCFA
name_zh: 浙江禾川科技股份有限公司
summary: Develops industrial automation and motion-control products, and offers five-finger hands through its robotics business.

name: HECBOT
summary: HECBOT, also known as Guanggu Dongzhi, is a Wuhan company founded in February 2025 that designs and produces robot bodies and develops applications for mixed robot fleets. Its Lumen robot family serves settings including elderly care, media and entertainment. The company identifies Agibot and the Peking University Wuhan Institute for Artificial Intelligence among its shareholders and operates humanoid robot production and testing facilities in Wuhan.

name: Hefei Boya Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 合肥伯牙智能科技有限公司
summary: Develops dexterous hands and robotics products.

name: Heshi Thinking
summary: Heshi Thinking is a Beijing robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in 2023. It develops embodied control software and its own robot platforms, including a full-size biped and wheeled manipulation systems. Its products target commercial service, cleaning, inspection and household tasks. The company also describes software integration with third-party robots; Humanoid-X is separately identified as its own humanoid platform in its official exhibitor material.

name: Heyman
name_zh: 杭州黑漫科技有限公司
summary: Develops underwater and general-purpose dexterous hands, including the WA100 underwater five-finger hand.

name: HHS Robotics
summary: HHS Robotics is a Shanghai company developing embodied robots, commercial service robots and consumer robots. Its portfolio includes humanoid platforms for research and education, robot hands and commercial systems. The company presents Romeo R1 as a modular bipedal research platform and provides hardware and software interfaces for teaching, system integration and robot behavior development.

name: High Torque Robotics
summary: High Torque Robotics is a Guangzhou-based robotics company developing compact humanoid research platforms, servo joint modules and robotic arms. Its Mini Pi Plus platform is intended for scientific research, teaching and robot competitions. The company emphasizes modular hardware and an open software ecosystem for developers, with Python and C++ interfaces, ROS support and simulation resources. The current official Chinese website identifies the business as Guangzhou High Torque Power Technology Co., Ltd. (Guangzhou Gaoqing Dynamics Technology Co., Ltd.), trading as Gaoqing Dynamics.

name: HITBOT
name_zh: 慧灵科技（深圳）有限公司
summary: Develops grippers and robotic manipulation systems.

name: HokMind
summary: HokMind develops biomimetic interactive robots that give digital characters a physical form. The company combines robot structures, facial control, artificial intelligence, character design and biomimetic materials for expressive interaction. Its Primal product series includes desktop and full-body platforms for entertainment, brand presentation and immersive experiences. The legal company is registered under a Beijing name; its corporate website also identifies Shanghai as an operating location.

name: HONOR
summary: HONOR is a Shenzhen-based device company whose portfolio spans phones, computers, tablets and wearables. It has expanded into embodied AI and humanoid robotics, presenting the HONOR Robotics D1 and A1 at the 2026 Beijing E-Town humanoid robot half-marathon. Its D1 platform emphasizes dynamic bipedal movement, autonomous perception and navigation. The company markets robotics alongside its broader AI device ecosystem.

name: HOSON
summary: HOSON is the brand of Shenzhen Xinyichang Technology, a Shenzhen manufacturer of high-precision semiconductor equipment. The company develops embodied robots through its wholly owned Shenzhen Xinyichang Robotics subsidiary, drawing on its motion-control and equipment engineering work. Its HOSON-Robot platform targets material handling and assembly tasks in semiconductor and electronics production.

name: Hubei Qirobotics
summary: Hubei Qirobotics, known in Chinese as Qiling Robotics, develops humanoid and quadruped robots in Wuhan. Its work combines robot body design, motion control, perception and decision systems for inspection, emergency response, manufacturing, logistics and research. The company identifies research links with Huazhong University of Science and Technology and markets the Shennong humanoid and Chitu quadruped families.

name: Hypetrix (Hysense)
name_zh: 深圳超维传感科技有限公司
summary: Hypetrix, also identified as Hysense, is the tactile-sensing brand presented by Shenzhen Chaowei Sensing Technology Co., Ltd. It develops fingertip and finger-pad tactile sensors, thin-film pressure arrays and tactile data-collection gloves for dexterous hands, robot skin and manipulation research.

name: iFLYTEK
summary:
iFLYTEK develops speech, language, vision and cognitive AI technology, with applications spanning education, healthcare, industry and intelligent devices. Its Spark model family provides a foundation for understanding and generating language, while its speech and multimodal systems support interaction between people and machines.

In robotics, its Robot Super Brain platform connects multimodal interaction with model-based understanding and decision-making. This places iFLYTEK primarily in the intelligence and interaction layer of the humanoid ecosystem.

name: IIMT
summary: IIMT, known in Chinese as Jicui Intelligent Manufacturing, develops robotics and intelligent manufacturing technology in Nanjing. Established in 2016 by the Jiangsu Industrial Technology Research Institute, Nanjing Jiangbei New Area and Professor Luo Minzhou’s team, the company develops platforms for industrial automation and embodied intelligence. Its Jizhi A1 combines a humanoid upper body with a mobile base for manipulation, research and human interaction.

name: ImprintX
name_zh: 知行具身（北京）科技有限公司
summary: ImprintX is a Beijing-based developer of tactile sensing hardware, data acquisition and perception technology for robot manipulation. Its physical portfolio includes the event-driven Imprint X visuotactile sensor and the Imprint Glove system of fingertip sensors and wrist hubs.

name: Inovance
name_zh: 深圳市汇川技术股份有限公司
summary: Inovance is a Chinese industrial automation and drive technology manufacturer. Its component portfolio includes servo drives, servo motors and precision direct-drive motion products. These components serve machine automation and motion-control applications alongside the group’s broader industrial businesses.

name: INSPIRE ROBOTS
name_zh: 北京因时机器人科技有限公司
summary: Develops miniature electric cylinders and anthropomorphic dexterous hands.

name: JAKA
summary:
JAKA develops collaborative robots, humanoid platforms and integrated automation systems. Its established industrial offering combines robot arms with vision and control technology for applications such as assembly, machine loading, sorting, handling, dispensing and inspection. The portfolio serves sectors including automotive production, electronics, appliances and food service.

The company is also developing embodied-intelligence products, including small humanoids and systems for mobile manipulation and robot-data collection.

name: Jiangsu DINGS' Intelligent Control Technology Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 江苏鼎智智能控制科技股份有限公司
summary: DINGS develops motion-control components including linear actuators, stepper motors, coreless motors, frameless torque motors and voice-coil motors. Its portfolio covers rotary and linear motion configurations for equipment integration.

name: Jiangsu Longsheng Weirui Embodied Intelligent Robotics Innovation Center Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 江苏隆盛唯睿具身智能机器人创新中心有限公司
summary: Longsheng-affiliated research and development company working on humanoid robots, dexterous hands and precision-manufacturing applications.

name: Jingchu Robot
summary: Jingchu Robot is a Wuhan manufacturer of humanoid robots and core components, founded in April 2025. It develops linear-drive robot bodies, motion control and embodied intelligence systems. Its product range serves research, education, industry and service applications, including the compact Xiaochu robot with articulated arms and a wheeled lower body.

name: Jinma
summary: Jinma is a Zhongshan manufacturer of amusement equipment and cultural tourism products. It is extending its mechanical engineering, electrical control and attraction operations into embodied robotics for theme parks, scenic areas and commercial venues. Its controlled Jinma Matrix venture, established with Shanghai Matrix, develops humanoid visitor-service products including Xiaoma 1.

name: JODELL ROBOTICS
name_zh: 苏州钧舵机器人有限公司
summary: Develops industrial end effectors.

name: Joyful Embodied
summary: Joyful Embodied is a robotics company founded in Fuzhou, China, in 2025. It develops embodied intelligence systems spanning robot hardware, models and data collection, and provides deployment and maintenance services for industrial, commercial, education and research applications. Its own product range includes the FORTIS W1 wheeled humanoid. The company also distributes ecosystem partner robots, which are listed separately from its self-developed products on its website. Joyful Embodied is headquartered in Fuzhou Software Park and has branches in Beijing and Nanchang.

name: KCS
name_zh: 深圳宽诚集成电路技术有限公司
summary: KCS designs analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits in Shenzhen. Its servo-control IC portfolio supports model-aircraft and robot servos, with external-drive controller ICs and integrated H-bridge devices. It also supplies general motor and gate-driver ICs and application engineering support.

name: KEENON Robotics
summary:
KEENON Robotics develops service robots and integrated solutions for commercial environments. Founded in 2010, the company expanded from autonomous delivery into applications including guidance, disinfection and other service tasks. Its robots are used in settings such as restaurants, hotels, hospitals, retail venues and industrial facilities.

The business combines autonomous mobility with product forms designed for particular workflows. International offices and support operations help adapt deployments to different markets.

name: Keli Motor Group Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 科力尔电机集团股份有限公司
summary: Keli Motor develops electric motors and motion-control products. Its robotics and automation portfolio includes high-performance and low-voltage servo motors, hybrid and permanent-magnet stepper motors, and brushless DC motors.

name: Kepler
summary: Shanghai Kepler Robotics Co., Ltd. is a high-tech innovation company focused on the development, production and application ecosystem of general-purpose humanoid robots. It aims to build industry-leading 'blue-collar' humanoid robots that can be deployed in practice. The company targets intelligent manufacturing, warehousing and logistics, specialized industries, research and data collection, providing customized intelligent solutions driven by innovation.

name: Kinco
name_zh: 上海步科自动化股份有限公司
summary: Kinco develops industrial automation and motion-control components. Its robotics portfolio includes frameless torque motors, low-voltage servo drives, integrated servo motors and wheel modules for mobile robots. The company is headquartered in Shanghai.

name: Kinetix Ai
summary:
Kinetix AI develops embodied intelligence with a focus on highly anthropomorphic robots. Founded in July 2025, it works across robot hardware, cognition, dexterous manipulation and data infrastructure. Its portfolio includes the KaiBot humanoid platform and KAI Hand, alongside tools for gathering human-centered training data.

KAI Halo Lite and the KAI EGO Dataset form part of this data pipeline, while SMASH is used to test capabilities. The company aims to connect human-like physical design with learning methods grounded in real-world activity.

name: KNOWIN
summary: KNOWIN develops embodied intelligent systems for consumer homes. These systems have a physical form and support continuous interaction in real environments through a perception–generation–execution–evolution loop. Using independently developed full-stack technology, a new generative embodied foundation-model system and an innovative synthetic-data approach, the company aims to improve robots' generalization across complex home environments, reliable execution of long task sequences and dependable delivery.

name: Laifual
name_zh: 浙江来福谐波传动股份有限公司
summary: Laifual develops and manufactures harmonic reducers and integrated robot joint modules. Its joint-module range includes AC high-voltage and DC low-voltage families that combine reduction gearing, motors and position feedback for industrial and articulated robotic mechanisms.

name: Lanxin Robotics
summary:
Lanxin Robotics develops industrial mobile robots built around 3D visual perception. Its technology links environmental sensing with navigation and practical factory operations, using deployed mobile platforms to connect AI capabilities with physical work. The company emphasizes industrial integration and customer value rather than navigation demonstrations in isolation.

Its public history describes progression from commercial mobile-robot deployments to supply relationships with manufacturers including Huawei and BYD.

name: Launchy
name_zh: 杭州峦启机器人科技有限公司
summary: Develops dexterous robotic and prosthetic hands.

name: LDROBOT
summary: LDROBOT (Shenzhen LDROBOT Co., Ltd.; Shenzhen LeDong Robotics Co., Ltd.) is a Shenzhen-based robotics company founded in 2017. It develops perception components and navigation technology for physical robots, including rotating DTOF and triangulation LiDAR, solid-state line sensors, ultrasonic sensors, multi-camera vision modules and developer kits. Its manufacturer documentation also covers embedded navigation boards and depth-camera modules. These components support mapping, navigation, obstacle detection and other perception tasks in household, commercial, industrial and research robots.

name: Leader Harmonious Drive Systems
name_zh: 苏州绿的谐波传动科技股份有限公司
summary: Leader Harmonious Drive Systems, trading as Leaderdrive, develops and manufactures strain-wave reducers and rotary actuators for robotics and precision automation. Its catalog includes compact, hollow-shaft and flat harmonic-drive families, alongside integrated rotary actuators.

name: Leadshine
name_zh: 深圳市雷赛智能控制股份有限公司
summary: Provides motion control and dexterous hand solutions.

name: LEJU ROBOT
summary:
Leju Robotics develops humanoid platforms for research, commercial services and industrial applications. Its Kuavo family includes full-size bipedal and wheeled-arm configurations, with current products presented as open platforms for embodied-intelligence development. The company supplies both robot hardware and application-oriented solutions.

Public use cases include exhibition guidance, retail assistance, banking services and tasks in automotive manufacturing, electronics and logistics.

name: LENFOR
name_zh: 深圳市蓝方技术有限公司
summary: LENFOR is the brand of Shenzhen Lanfang Technology Co., Ltd., a motor-control and precision-transmission developer within Mannst. Its current component portfolio comprises parallel and adaptive electric grippers, rotary grippers, long-stroke grippers, miniature electric cylinders, electric slides and a five-finger anthropomorphic hand. The company’s official address is in Longgang District, Shenzhen.

name: LH-TC
name_zh: 郑州领航机器人有限公司
summary: LH-TC (LHTC), operated by Zhengzhou Linghang Robot, develops and manufactures robot end-effector components. Its portfolio includes automatic tool changers, electrical and fluid transfer modules, pneumatic grippers, finger changers, compensation units, grinding equipment and energy-docking assemblies. The company identifies its production base in Zhengzhou.

name: Li-Gong
summary: Li-Gong develops industrial humanoid robots, collaborative mobile robots and factory software in Guangzhou. Its manufacturer brochure presents the Lidian humanoid family alongside machine-tending, logistics and material-handling systems. The company supplies robot hardware and digital factory tools for coordinating work across manufacturing environments.

name: LimX Dynamics
summary: LimX Dynamics is an embodied intelligent robot manufacturer focused on the development, production and commercialization of general-purpose robots. Its products include the fully autonomous LimX Oli and LimX Luna humanoids and the modular TRON robot series. The company pursues disruptive Physical AI innovation through three core technologies: original robot hardware design and manufacturing, integrated high-level intelligence and motion control, and the COSA humanoid brain system.

name: LindenBot
summary: LindenBot is a Hefei robotics company backed by iFLYTEK. It develops embodied intelligence models and robot hardware as integrated systems for industrial tasks. The company’s LDB01 platform combines a mobile body, lifting torso and coordinated dual arms with perception and task-planning software. LindenBot targets manufacturing and logistics applications, including automotive and electronics production.

name: Lingwei Era Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
summary: 灵尾纪元是一家宠物AI智能硬件产品研发商,灵尾纪元基于足够的用户数据、硬件科技、智能算法,以及多模态传感器、持续学习的 AI 创新战略。通过软硬件的结合,灵尾纪元重做了整个宠物生态的智能硬件、软件服务、耗材、⻝品 、宠物医疗等全生命周期管理。

name: Lingzhang
name_zh: 无锡灵掌机器人科技有限公司
summary: Develops robotic dexterous hands and automation solutions for industrial and research users.

name: LinkerBot
name_zh: 灵心巧手（北京）科技有限公司
summary: Develops dexterous hands and teleoperation platforms.

name: Linksoon
name_zh: 深圳市灵枢动力有限公司
summary: Linksoon develops precision transmission components and integrated robot joints. Its portfolio includes LSH harmonic joint modules, LSP planetary joint modules, and LH hat-type and LC cup-type harmonic reducers for humanoid, collaborative and industrial robots. The Shenzhen company was founded in 2025 and states that it received strategic investment from Fenda Technology.

name: Live Electronics
summary: Shenzhen Live Electronics Co., Ltd. develops and supplies custom electronic control boards and PCBA solutions. Its explicit robot-controller range contains patrol-robot and cleaning-robot boards; the company also offers unrelated home, industrial and power electronics. Published robot model tables are configuration baselines for custom integration.

name: Lumos
name_zh: 鹿明机器人科技（深圳）有限公司
summary:
Lumos Robotics develops embodied-intelligence robots for industrial deployment. Its portfolio includes the LUS full-size bipedal humanoid, MOS heavy-duty wheeled dual-arm robot, NIX mini humanoid and LUD wheeled-legged platform. These different forms address varying requirements for reach, mobility and physical work.

The company connects robot development with data gathered from practical industrial settings. Its public materials describe partnerships with companies including Mitsubishi Electric Intelligent Manufacturing in China and COSCO SHIPPING.

name: Luxshare
name_zh: 立讯精密工业股份有限公司
summary: Develops and manufactures precision components and systems, including a self-developed tendon-driven dexterous hand disclosed in investor materials.

name: Magic Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: 魔力信息是一家专注指纹识别和人工智能的科技企业,向客户提供指纹识别算法、指纹芯片、专业服务和身份识别解决方案。

name: MagicLab
summary:
MagicLab develops general-purpose humanoid robots and embodied-intelligence technology. Founded in January 2024, it combines robot research, product development and application work, with a portfolio spanning humanoid and quadruped forms. Its broader scope includes the engineering and delivery activities required to turn prototypes into usable products.

The company targets a range of industrial, commercial and household scenarios.

name: Matrix
name_zh: 上海矩阵超智系统集成有限公司
summary:
Matrix Robotics, also known as Matrix Hyperintelligence, develops humanoid robots and the AI systems that control their interaction with the physical world. Its MATRIX-3 platform is presented as a third-generation design combining updated hardware, perception and intelligent behavior.

The company's technical focus includes biomimetic surfaces, tactile sensing and dexterous manipulation, connecting contact information with robot movement and decision-making. Its stated direction is to extend robots from specialized industrial settings toward a wider range of everyday environments.

name: Mech-Mind Robotics
summary: Mech-Mind Robotics develops industrial 3D cameras and software that enable robots to perceive objects and execute manipulation tasks. Its portfolio includes Mech-Eye cameras, machine-vision and robot-programming software, and integrated robotic stations. Its systems support industrial work such as bin picking, machine tending, assembly, inspection and palletizing. The company maintains an office in Beijing and other locations in China and overseas.

name: Midea
summary:
Midea combines a large home-appliance business with industrial automation and robotics development. Its robotics innovation work covers core components, robotized appliances and complete embodied systems, connecting robot engineering with both household products and manufacturing operations.

Its disclosed portfolio includes MIRO for industrial settings, MIRA for commercial and domestic applications, and the MIRA X bipedal platform.

name: MindOn
name_zh: 灵启万物（深圳）科技有限公司
summary:
MindOn develops general-purpose robot intelligence intended to work across different physical platforms. Its model combines perception, reasoning and action, with training based on large-scale human data rather than a separate model for each individual task. The company presents this as a way to make robot deployment more adaptable across environments.

Its public demonstrations include practical household activities and logistics workflows involving multiple robots. The emphasis is therefore on the intelligence and coordination layer that allows different bodies to perform useful work.

name: MINDSYNC TECH
name_zh: 安徽中科灵犀科技有限公司
summary: Develops five-finger robotic hands, control systems and industrial manipulation solutions.

name: MirrorMe
name_zh: 镜识科技（上海）有限公司
summary: Develops humanoid robots and dexterous hands, including the VIVA hand demonstrated at the World Robot Conference.

name: MOONS'
name_zh: 上海鸣志电器股份有限公司
summary: MOONS' develops and manufactures motion-control components and systems. Its portfolio includes stepper and servo motors, miniature coreless and slotless motors, drives, motion controllers and mobile-robot wheel assemblies. The company is headquartered in Shanghai.

name: Morphi Robot
summary:
Morphi Robot, operated by Shenzhen Moqi Intelligent Technology, develops humanoid hardware and embodied AI as an integrated system. Its research combines foundation models, data collection and methods for transferring learned capabilities across environments. The core architecture connects generation, understanding and decision-making.

The company aims to support autonomous movement, physical manipulation and natural interaction through a common development stack. Its long-term product direction is household assistance, with robot experience feeding back into model and system improvements.

name: Nanchang Kude Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 南昌酷德智能科技有限公司
summary: Nanchang Kude operates the CubeMars motor brand. Its portfolio includes robotic actuators, quasi-direct-drive motors, frameless torque motors, gimbal motors and underwater thrusters for robotic motion and propulsion.

name: Nantong Zhenkang Welding Electromachinery Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 南通振康焊接机电有限公司
summary: Nantong Zhenkang manufactures precision RV reducers, welding wire-feed mechanisms and related automation components. Its RV reducer portfolio serves industrial robot transmission applications. The company is based in Haimen District, Nantong.

name: NeodraDynamics
summary: NeodraDynamics is a Beijing robotics company developing hydraulic-electric drive systems and heavy-duty humanoid robots. Its portfolio combines digital hydraulic actuators, dexterous hands and humanoid arms for physically demanding industrial and hazardous-environment tasks. The company presented its Neo1 humanoid at the 2026 World Robot Conference. Its products target applications such as heavy assembly, material handling, mining and emergency response; these are manufacturer-described applications rather than independently verified deployments.

name: NeoteAI
name_zh: 上海新智具身智能科技有限公司
summary: NeoteAI develops optical tactile sensors and tactile grippers for robot manipulation, alongside tactile data collection and embodied intelligence models. Its InTac hardware serves industrial grippers, dexterous hands and contact-rich robot control.

name: NEXFORM
summary:
NEXFORM (Xinyuanti) develops general-purpose embodied robots, key components and application solutions. The company is associated with technology transfer from a Zhejiang University robotics research team and describes a modular approach that can support multiple robot forms.

Its development strategy connects hardware, operational data and industry applications. Public materials identify hospitality and property management as important commercial settings, alongside work on remote operation and data collection.

name: Ningbo Future Era Robotics
name_zh: 宁波未来时代机器人有限公司
summary: Ningbo Future Era Robotics develops wheeled humanoid robots for industrial applications such as machining and flexible manufacturing. Its manufacturer-provided World Robot Conference profile presents industrial, heavy-duty and folding-waist humanoid platforms. The company identifies its wholly owned Shanghai Spider Robot subsidiary as its research and development center in Zhangjiang, Shanghai. Its product brochure uses the Spider Robot brand.

name: Ningbo Junsheng Lingxi Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 宁波均胜灵犀智能科技有限公司
summary: Joyson-affiliated company developing dexterous hands, tactile sensing, joint actuators and manipulation platforms.

name: Ningbo Zhongda Leader Intelligent Transmission
name_zh: 宁波中大力德智能传动股份有限公司
summary: Ningbo Zhongda Leader Intelligent Transmission develops and manufactures motor drives, geared motors, precision reducers and integrated motion units. Its range serves industrial automation, logistics and robotics; the planetary-reducer families listed here are components rather than complete robots.

name: Noetix Robotics
summary:
Noetix Robotics (Songyan Dynamics) develops humanoid robots with a focus on motion, accessible interaction and consumer-facing use. Its public product and demonstration activity includes compact humanoids and bionic robot heads, connecting physical movement with expressive human–robot communication.

The company's current materials emphasize making robots available beyond specialized laboratories, including public demonstrations and consumer-oriented deliveries.

name: OpenLoong
summary:
OpenLoong is an open-source humanoid robotics project incubated by the OpenAtom Foundation and operated by Humanoid Robot (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. It aims to make the process of creating and developing humanoid robots more accessible through shared hardware, software and community resources.

The project's portfolio includes the Qinglong reference humanoid and Qinglong Mini, with associated datasets and development materials. These resources support work on robot control, learning and application development.

name: Openmind Robotics
summary: Openmind Robotics, operated by Qizhi (Wuhu) Intelligent Robot Co., Ltd., develops a general technology platform for intelligent robots. Established in 2024 by EFORT and investment partners, the Wuhu company combines its Openmind OS, Modou development tools and Dayan data platform with the Yobot robot family. Its humanoid platforms support motion research and physical work, including demonstrations of retail shelf stocking.

name: Orbbec Inc.
summary: Orbbec develops and manufactures 3D cameras, depth-processing chips and vision systems for robotics and other machine-perception applications. Its camera portfolio includes stereo, time-of-flight and structured-light products, supported by software development tools and integration services. The company is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

name: OYMotion Technologies Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 上海傲意信息科技有限公司
summary: Develops neural interfaces and robotic dexterous hands.

name: PaXini
summary:
PaXini develops tactile sensing, dexterous hands and humanoid robotics as a connected embodied-intelligence stack. Founded in 2021, the company builds multidimensional sensing technology intended to give robots more information about contact and physical interaction. Its portfolio includes tactile sensors, DexH hands and the TORA-ONE humanoid platform.

The company also develops data-collection infrastructure and OmniVTLA models combining vision, touch, language and action. Its role spans supplying components to other robot developers and building complete systems.

name: Percipio
summary: Percipio supplies industrial 3D cameras and machine-vision software for industrial automation, logistics and mobile robotics. Its camera range covers time-of-flight, dot-pattern structured light and fringe-pattern structured light. The company also develops RVS Machine Vision Software for industrial automation applications. Its official company profile identifies Shanghai as its headquarters.

name: PHYBOT
summary:
PHYBOT develops robots through joint design of AI software and physical hardware. Its stated mission is to bring AI into the physical world, treating a robot's body as an integral part of the intelligence system rather than a separate machine controlled afterward.

The company's approach, described as 'Robots for AI,' emphasizes the relationship between a robot's structure and the capabilities its software can learn and execute.

name: PIA Automation
summary: PIA Automation is an industrial automation group headquartered in Ningbo, China. It supplies manufacturing systems for automotive, energy-storage, medical and consumer-goods applications. The group also develops humanoid robot technology through its wholly owned AI and Humanoid Robotics Research Institute, whose published products include the JARVIS humanoid series. Its broader embodied-robotics activity includes joint research and manufacturing ventures.

name: PL Universe
summary:
PL Universe develops embodied robots for industrial work, combining complete machines with AI and deployment services. Founded in Suzhou in January 2025, the company presents its ProWhite robot as a platform for adaptable physical automation. Its technology architecture connects sensing, decision-making and action to support tasks in operating environments.

The company's target markets include electronics and automotive manufacturing. It emphasizes adapting robots to customer processes, collecting operational data and improving capabilities through continued use.

name: PNDbotics
summary:
PNDbotics develops humanoid robots, integrated actuators and the manufacturing capabilities needed to produce them. Its Adam platform is designed around human-like body structure and movement, while its PSA modular actuators provide a foundation for robot joints and motion control.

The company offers hardware configurations and development support for robot training, control and real-world data collection. Its PND-IMC manufacturing center connects research and design with production.

name: PsiBot
summary:
PsiBot develops embodied AI for dexterous physical manipulation. Founded in 2024, the company combines robot platforms, end-to-end learning models and real-world data collection to improve how robots handle objects and carry out tasks. Its research includes a joint laboratory with Peking University.

The company's PSI model work is supported by PsiSynEngine, a system for collecting and using physical interaction data. Its public materials describe early application validation in logistics and warehouse settings.

name: Pudu Robotics
summary: Pudu Robotics develops and manufactures commercial service robots. Built around mobility, manipulation and AI, it pioneered a 'one brain, multiple forms' architecture and established a complete portfolio of specialized, semi-humanoid and humanoid robots. Pudu has four product lines: delivery, cleaning, industrial and general-purpose embodied intelligence. Its products are used in retail, hotels, industry, warehousing and logistics, food service, property cleaning, healthcare, entertainment and sports, education, public transport and public services.

Established at the end of 2022 with the group’s reducer operating assets, it develops, manufactures and sells precision transmission components. Its portfolio continues Qinchuan’s earlier robot-reducer business.

name: Qingbao Robot
summary: Qingbao Robot is a Shanghai manufacturer of humanlike service robots. It develops robot bodies and embodied intelligence technology for visitor guidance, reception, education, live streaming and beverage-service applications. The company describes work on robot control, expressive heads, flexible joint actuators and dexterous hands, and markets both fixed and mobile service-robot configurations. Its official corporate identity is Shanghai Qingbao Engine Robot Co., Ltd.

name: Quzhi Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
summary: 趣之科技是一个以算法和云技术为核心,传感器和机器人为产品的研发公司,致力提供基于互联网云计算的个人机器人(Personal Robot)应用服务。

name: Ramda (Shenzhen) Night Vision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: 拉姆达是一家热成像AI产品研发商,专注于远红外热成像传感器在车载场景的人、车目标分类算法研发、制造、销售,主打产品汽车热成像夜视仪,实现高效的人、车识别功能,可解决恶劣天气对汽车安全驾驶的影响、夜间视线不佳、远光炫目短暂致盲等问题,大大提高驾驶安全,在辅助驾驶、矿场用车、军警用车、无人码头等有大量使用需求。

name: Realmagic Semiconductors (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
summary: 锐盟半导体是一家智能人机界面处理器芯片及解决方案提供商。专注于智能触觉感知、智能语音唤醒与识别、智能脑机接口等芯片的研发,率先提出“用户定义界面”的概念,应用领域涵盖TWS耳机、智能手机、智能物联网、可穿戴式智能设备、智能车载、健康医疗等。

name: Reconova
summary: Reconova is an AI technology company with an office in Xiamen that develops visual intelligence products and enterprise systems. Its established applications include airports, commercial premises and driver safety. The company is extending its perception and decision technology into embodied robots, including baggage-handling platforms and a wheeled humanoid with two arms.

name: Robbyant (Ant Group)
summary:
Robbyant is an Ant Group company developing embodied AI and robotics technology. Its work spans spatial perception, action models, reward models and the tools needed to connect AI decision-making with physical interaction. It works with intelligent-hardware partners to turn these capabilities into robot applications.

The company identifies home assistance, elderly care and medical support among its intended application areas.

name: RoboParty
summary: RoboParty is a Shanghai company developing bipedal humanoid robots and open-source robotics platforms. Its work combines mechanical design, embedded electronics, motion control and engineering documentation for education, research and developer use. The company publishes the Roboto Origin humanoid platform with material covering its structure, electrical system, training and deployment.

name: RoboScience
summary: RoboScience is an embodied robotics developer established in 2024. It develops its Visics embodied model, the RoboMirage simulation engine and its own mobile manipulation hardware. The company works on robot operation across retail, logistics, industrial and household settings. Its published corporate brochure lists research and production locations in Beijing, Shenzhen, Suzhou and Hangzhou, while its World Robot Conference exhibitor identifies the Beijing legal entity.

name: RobotEra
summary:
RobotEra develops embodied AI systems, robot platforms and dexterous hands. Its work connects complete robot hardware with models for perception, task understanding and physical action, with logistics identified as an early focus for commercial applications.

The company presents its products as a connected family of embodied systems, including the XHAND line of robotic hands. Its research also explores world models as a foundation for robot intelligence beyond individual action policies.

name: SCATECH

Its Shenzhen-based control portfolio serves machine builders and system integrators, with robotics listed as a multi-axis control application. The catalog includes independent and modular I/O, SCIPC computers and molded or assembled EtherCAT cables.

name: Seizet Technology(Shen Zhen) Co., Ltd.

name: Shen Zhen GLI Technology Limited
summary: GLI develops intelligent soft robotic hands and focuses on innovative robotics products. It has received expressions of interest in orders from companies in healthcare, automotive, logistics, retail and electronics. Its business covers industrial robots, medical rehabilitation robots and consumer service robots.

name: Shen Zhen Hiker Technology Co., Ltd.

该公司在AI领域取得技术突破,自主研发的Real2Sim全流程方案亮相英伟达GTC2026大会,成为主展台核心展项的独家技术提供方,解决了具身智能产业落地的关键难题。

summary: 智空未来是一家低空无人机反制解决方案提供商,致力于运用智能无线电技术,让物联网环境更安全。核心产品蓝天卫士无人机反制系统,具有“无源探测,精准识别,无人值守,低干扰”等特性,该解决方案利用尖端的射频频谱感应,信号处理,人工智能和机器学习技术来解码底层协议以检测无人机。

深圳中杰智控科技有限公司成立于2019年8月,法定代表人王吉明,位于广东省深圳市南山区。公司专注于机械电气设备制造、工业控制计算机及系统的研发与销售,在智能控制领域拥有多项专利技术,包括基于机器听觉的托辊故障诊断设备和灯具智能控制系统等。公司开发的智能通信控台状态监控软件、LED防爆灯智能调控平台等软件系统,体现了其在工业自动化控制领域的技术积累。
深圳中杰智控科技有限公司在2024年获得国家级高新技术企业认定,2025年入选国家级科技型中小企业。该公司依托深圳南山区在智能制造领域的政策支持和技术创新环境,专注于工业自动化控制系统的研发与应用,其基于机器听觉的故障诊断技术和智能控制系统在细分领域具有技术优势。

深圳市中科智清新能源科技有限公司成立于2020年4月8日,法定代表人章斌,公司位于广东省深圳市南山区。企业专注于智能机器人技术研发、储能技术服务以及新能源原动设备销售领域。公司在技术研发方面拥有多项专利,包括抽油机、碳纤维复合材料油井举升连接器、远程控制节能液压抽油机以及抽油杆安全接头等创新成果。
深圳市中科智清新能源科技有限公司入选2023粤港澳大湾区科创榜---深港澳科创新锐企业TOP100榜单。该公司地处粤港澳大湾区核心区域,能够充分利用该地区在新能源领域的产业集聚效应和政策支持优势。在储能技术研发方面,该公司拥有多项专利技术积累,包括抽油机、碳纤维复合材料等创新成果,为其在新能源设备领域提供了技术竞争力。

name: Shenzhen Zhuoyu Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: 卓驭科技专注于智能驾驶系统研发,提供涵盖控制器、传感器硬件及全栈算法的自动驾驶解决方案,主导产品“成行平台”支持乘用车高阶智能驾驶功能实现。

name: SIASUN
name_zh: 沈阳新松机器人自动化股份有限公司
summary:
SIASUN develops industrial, mobile and specialized robots together with integrated manufacturing systems. Founded in Shenyang in 2000, the company supplies equipment and solutions for welding, assembly and logistics automation, with applications across automotive, electronics, semiconductors and other production sectors.

Its embodied-robotics portfolio extends this industrial base into mobile manipulation and humanoid systems. Publicly introduced platforms include wheeled and lifting humanoids in the Ruike family, the Songyi wheeled humanoid and the Songxing bipedal robot.

name: Siheria TECHNOLOGIES
summary: 矽赫科技是一家由硅谷海归团队创立且行业领先的智能光电创新企业,专注半导体、人工智能、激光、太赫兹通信、成像等领域,推动技术和产业革新, 矽赫科技科研团队长期从事太赫兹技术零辐射、全息提取、激光、AI引擎智能边缘计算、深度神经网络、多维度监测、超高频在半导体材料、激光的性质研究、以及断层成像技术这些关键技术等领域的研究工作。经过核心团队矽赫科技在海外多年的前沿科研沉淀以及团队自身的国际前沿、独一无二的技术优势,已形成“太赫兹+®®”和“AI+”工业、交通和医疗核心产品底座,为全球市场提供“Tera+ ®”系列打造创新技术和产品。 矽赫科技商品和服务广泛运用于智能制造、智慧交通、智慧城市,多项落地产品入选国家省市区等权威目录。 矽赫科技曾获多家海内外等权威媒体报道。

name: Simple AI
summary: Simple AI is a Beijing company developing general-purpose embodied robots for service environments. It combines its own mobile manipulation hardware with models, task planning and data collection systems. The company uses hotel and other household-like commercial settings as an initial deployment environment, with the longer-term aim of household robotics. Its Xiaopu Simbot has been publicly demonstrated performing service and household-style tasks at the 2026 World Robot Conference.

name: SKYLANDX
name_zh: 深圳市无穹创新科技有限公司
summary:
SKYLANDX is an intelligent hardware company focused on spatial intelligence, covering the complete chain from spatial perception and localization/mapping to intelligent control. Since its founding in 2020, it has concentrated on three core technologies: robot localization, perception and path planning. It has independently developed intelligent hardware and solutions including 3D spatial scanners, indoor inspection drones and intelligent inspection robots.
The company was the first team incubated at HKCRC (Hong Kong Center for Construction Robotics), founded by Professor Li Zexiang.

name: Spirit AI
summary:
Spirit AI develops general-purpose intelligence for robots, focusing on models that connect perception, task understanding and physical interaction. Founded in January 2024, the company aims to give robots skills that transfer between tasks and environments, rather than requiring a separate fixed program for each situation.

Its Spirit model family, including Spirit v1.5, is evaluated on robot-manipulation benchmarks such as RoboChallenge. The company's work centers on translating learned AI capabilities into detailed actions in the real world.

name: SRED Security and Surveillance Technology Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 深圳砺剑防卫技术有限公司
summary:
深圳砺剑防卫技术有限公司成立于2014年5月21日,董事长为蔡文斌,位于广东省深圳市南山区。公司专注于安防设备制造、三类医疗器械生产和电子专用设备制造领域,拥有多项专利技术,包括手持式背散射X射线成像设备的图像矫正方法及装置、PID控制惯性伺服系统及控制方法等。公司在软件开发方面也具备实力,拥有基于模糊PID控制的惯性伺服系统软件、背散射X射线成像仪图像处理与系统控制软件等著作权。深圳砺剑防卫技术有限公司通过技术创新,在安防和医疗设备领域提供专业的产品和解决方案。
深圳砺剑防卫技术有限公司在2025年获得省级创新型中小企业称号,2024年入选省级专精特新中小企业,2023年被评为国家级高新技术企业。该公司在安防设备制造和医疗器械领域具备技术优势,拥有多项专利和软件著作权,包括手持式背散射X射线成像设备的图像矫正方法及装置等。

name: Stouching Robotics
summary: Stouching Robotics develops tactile sensors and data acquisition hardware for robotic manipulation and embodied AI training. Its portfolio includes optical tactile sensors, a tactile gripper, wearable capture devices and portable UMI data collection equipment.

name: Streamax Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: 锐明技术致力于以视频为核心的商用车监控信息化产品的研发、生产及销售。锐明技术以解决用户痛点、帮助用户创造价值为目标,以视频图像处理技术为核心,融合卫星定位、物联网传感器、车载电子工程及无线通讯等技术,不断对产品进行迭代更新,逐步发展形成了系统化、智能化的系统终端产品及行业解决方案。

name: Sudo Robotics
summary:
Sudo Robotics develops integrated robots and AI for physical manipulation. Its sudo R1 system combines internally developed hardware and software with a manipulation-focused foundation model. Object picking is the starting capability, reflecting the role of grasping in many larger tasks such as sorting, handling and assembly.

The company uses simulation-based training to build skills that can transfer to real-world objects and conditions. Its research emphasizes making physical execution reliable across varied situations, alongside the higher-level planning abilities of AI models.

name: Sunhe Energy
name_zh: 深圳市三和朝阳科技有限公司
summary: Shenzhen Sunhe Energy Co., Ltd. develops and supplies custom lithium battery cells and packs. Its robot-battery catalog lists cylindrical 18650 pack configurations. Six configurations have consistent source identity; three others remain unresolved because of conflicting model or manufacturer labels. The company identifies a Shenzhen headquarters and R&D base and a separate production base in Hubei.

name: Suzhou Yizhi Dexterous Drive Technology Co., Ltd.

name: SwitchBot
summary:
SwitchBot develops connected-home devices and embodied home robotics. Its product ecosystem includes retrofit controls, smart locks, curtains, sensors and household robots, bringing sensing and physical action together across the home. The company emphasizes integrating new capabilities into existing living spaces.

Its Omni Sense VLA technology connects visual input, spoken interaction and action, supporting coordination between robots and other devices.

name: Sycsense
name_zh: 赛感科技（深圳）有限公司
summary: Sycsense is a Shenzhen-based developer and manufacturer of flexible tactile sensors, electronic skin and sensor acquisition electronics. Founded in June 2023, the company commercializes technology originating from the Southern University of Science and Technology flexible electronics laboratory. Its products support tactile research, industrial grippers, dexterous robot hands and humanoid body sensing, alongside consumer, automotive and healthcare applications. The portfolio includes single-point and array pressure sensors, data collection modules and integrated tactile sensing systems.

name: SynapX Dynamics
name_zh: 北京章鱼灵动科技有限公司
summary: Develops tendon-driven robotic hands, tactile sensing and embodied manipulation systems under the SynapX Dynamics brand.

name: Taishen Technology Shenzhen Ltd
summary: 钛深科技是一家高科技型初创企业,开发并拥有全球首创的柔性离电子触觉传感技术(Flexible Iontronic Sensing),并提供世界上最灵敏和最柔性的人机感应及交互界面。公司专注于开发柔性触觉传感器及触觉AI解决方案,并致力于解决其在医疗、消费电子、机器人及智能汽车等领域的应用。钛深科技率先通过提供超高灵敏度及超强抗噪性能的触觉传感器、柔性人机交互界面以及可穿戴健康监测技术来解决目前市场上对于高精度、大阵列、超柔性的触觉传感需求,并提供相应的技术咨询服务。

name: Talls Gear
name_zh: 陶世智能科技（深圳）有限公司
summary: Talls Gear develops and manufactures precision miniature reducers using toroidal enveloping worm transmission. Its Shenzhen operation supplies transmission components for dexterous hands, grippers, humanoid robots and industrial automation. The current Talls Intelligent Technology company was established in 2024, following the predecessor Shenzhen Taoshi Precision Technology business founded in 2016.

name: TARS Robotics
name_zh: 上海它石智航技术有限公司
summary:
TARS Robotics (Tashi Zhihang) develops embodied intelligence and general-purpose robotics. Founded in 2025, the company works on connecting AI with physical interaction, including how robots learn manipulation skills from human activity.

Its World In Your Hands research ecosystem includes the Oracle Suite wearable data-collection system, a multimodal manipulation dataset and tools for annotation and evaluation. The project studies how human demonstrations can improve dexterous robot policies across varied objects and environments.

name: TC Drive
name_zh: 深圳市同川科技有限公司
summary: TC Drive develops and manufactures harmonic reducers, integrated rotary actuators and robot joint modules. Its portfolio includes industrial rotary transmission, collaborative robot joints and lightweight harmonic joints for humanoid robots.

name: TechWedali
name_zh: 深圳市伟达立创新科技有限公司
summary: TechWedali develops integrated robot joint modules and their drive, motor, encoder and transmission components. Founded in Shenzhen in 2024, the company was jointly established by Veichi Electric, Kedali and Shanghai Mirle. Its portfolio serves humanoid, collaborative, mobile and rehabilitation robots, with harmonic and planetary joint models documented in technical tables and additional component families under development or without published model specifications.
