name: TENDONBOT
name_zh: 苏州智行腱机器人科技有限公司
summary: Develops electrically actuated artificial tendons and biomimetic robotic hands, described by the company as non-motor and non-conventional-cable actuation.

name: TengenX AI
name_zh: 深圳天元兴科技有限公司
summary:
TengenX AI (Tianyuanxing Technology) is a leading Chinese industrial embodied intelligence robotics company, independently spun out by the core team of SenseTime's industrial robotics division. It develops its own end-to-end closed-loop control architecture and TengenX embodied foundation models, aiming to move industrial robots from passive instruction execution to autonomous, intelligent end-to-end control.

Its core product, the TX01 wheeled humanoid dual-arm robot, combines VLA and world models for perception, planning, prediction and control.

name: TetherIA
name_zh: 绳肌妙算（上海）机器人有限公司
summary: Develops tendon-driven robotic hands and open-source manipulation hardware under the TetherIA brand.

name: TetraBOT
summary: TetraBOT is a Nanjing robotics company founded in 2011. It develops robots, sensing hardware, diagnostic algorithms and industrial software for equipment inspection and maintenance. Its systems serve energy, petrochemical, mining and public infrastructure environments. The company’s humanoid portfolio includes T12, a mobile dual-arm robot designed to combine inspection with physical operation, and the Tian Kui explosion-proof humanoid.

name: TheoHand
name_zh: 万拿机器人（北京）有限公司
summary: Develops biomimetic multi-finger hands and miniature servo actuators for embodied manipulation.

name: Ti5 Robot
name_zh: 钛虎机器人科技(上海)有限公司
summary: Provides high-end robotics hardware and complete robotics solutions, specializing in customized robotics hardware services, research, development and production. Its products include high-performance lightweight joint modules, ultralight collaborative robots and humanoid robot reference designs.

name: Tianji Intelligent
summary:
Tianji Intelligent develops robots, control systems and automation products for industrial and commercial applications. Its portfolio covers several robot configurations in small and medium payload classes, supported by its internally developed Fusion control system.

The company applies these products to production processes in electronics, automotive electronics, new energy, medical equipment, home appliances and food manufacturing. Its offering combines standard robot hardware with application engineering, using process requirements to guide deployment.

name: TLIBOT
summary: TLIBOT is a Mianyang robot manufacturer founded in 2012. It develops humanoid robots, mobile manipulators, lightweight collaborative robots and core components for automation applications. Its Tianzhen Z1 platform combines a modular humanoid body with articulated hands and an expressive neck, waist and shoulders, allowing customer-specific appearance and application adaptation.

name: TOPSTAR Group
name_zh: 广东拓斯达科技股份有限公司
summary:
TOPSTAR develops intelligent manufacturing equipment, robot systems and embodied AI technology. Founded in Dongguan in 2007, the company combines industrial robots, CNC machine tools and injection-molding equipment with controls, servos, machine vision and software.

Its robotics portfolio spans Cartesian, articulated, collaborative and humanoid designs. The company uses industrial processes to guide product development, collecting information from spatial, visual and force sensors to improve robot capabilities.

name: TORCH
name_zh: 杭州炬坤机器人有限公司
summary: Develops industrial five-finger hands, multi-finger end effectors and manipulation solutions.

name: UBTECH
summary:
UBTECH develops humanoid robots and an ecosystem of hardware, AI, software and operating services. Founded in 2012, the company targets industrial, commercial and household applications, with development spanning robot bodies, actuators, perception, whole-body control and dexterous manipulation.

Its Thinker model family connects task understanding, world modeling and action generation. The company also develops simulation, training-data infrastructure and systems for coordinating multiple robots.

name: UniMAT Automation Technology CO.,LTD
name_zh: 深圳市亿维自动化技术有限公司
summary: 一般经营项目:智能型可编程控制器、仪器仪表、工业自动化设备、计算机软硬件、网络产品、高效节能技术、通讯设备的技术开发;国内贸易(不含专营、专控、专卖商品),从事货物、技术进出口业务(不含分销、国家专营专控商品)。许可经营项目:生产智能型可编程控制器、仪器仪表、工业自动化设备。

name: Unisunbot
name_zh: 浙江和晖机器人技术有限公司
summary: Unisunbot develops robot control systems, servo drives and integrated joints for quadruped, humanoid and industrial robots. The Hangzhou company combines motion-control hardware with real-time operating systems and learning-based control software. Its current portfolio includes joint-drive boards, planetary joint modules and dedicated quadruped and humanoid controllers.

name: Unitree Robotics
summary:
Unitree Robotics develops legged robots, humanoids and robotic manipulators for research, consumer and industrial applications. Its portfolio spans quadruped platforms and bipedal robots, supported by internally developed motors, reducers, controllers and sensing technology.

The company combines mechanical design with motion control and environmental perception to produce robots capable of dynamic movement. Its platforms are used for developing locomotion, interaction and embodied-AI applications, with different configurations serving different budgets and operating needs.

name: UniX AI
summary: UniX AI is a humanoid robotics company headquartered in Suzhou, China. It develops wheeled dual-arm and bipedal robots for home and commercial service applications, combining robot hardware with perception and manipulation software. Its product lineup includes Wanda, Panther and Martian. The company states that it was established in 2024.

name: UROVAS
name_zh: 深圳季连科技有限公司
summary: UROVAS is the robotics brand of Shenzhen Jilian Technology. Its Agile component portfolio spans miniature harmonic actuators, quasi-direct-drive planetary joints and heavier cycloidal joints for dexterous end effectors, wheeled-legged platforms, quadrupeds and humanoid robots. Its website also offers physical-AI software platforms and lists Siemens industrial-control products separately.

name: VEICHI
name_zh: 苏州伟创电气科技股份有限公司
summary: VEICHI develops industrial automation and electric-drive products. Its motion-control portfolio includes servo systems, integrated mobile-robot drives, frameless and coreless motors, gearboxes and robot-joint modules. The company is based in Suzhou, Jiangsu.

name: Vieta
name_zh: 广东赛韦达科技有限公司
summary: Vieta is the electric-actuation brand of Guangdong Saiweida Technology Co., Ltd. in Dongguan. The manufacturer develops electric grippers and integrated linear/rotary actuators for automated handling and robotic end-effectors. Its named portfolio includes gripping, rotary gripping, linear-slide and Z-axis/rotation modules.

name: ViHero
summary: ViHero is a Xianyang robot manufacturer founded in 2017 and identified by Beijing Vizum as its wholly owned robotics subsidiary. It develops humanoid robots, dexterous hands and stereo-vision systems, with facilities for robot design, production and testing. Its product portfolio includes bipedal, wheeled and agricultural-picking humanoid platforms intended for service, research and industrial applications.

name: Vita Dynamics
summary: Vita Dynamics is a Beijing robotics company operating under the Vbot brand. It develops consumer robots and an embodied-intelligence operating system for homes and other everyday environments. Its portfolio spans quadruped robots and announced humanoid designs, with research teams in Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen. Its humanoid program is presented as a prototype development effort; the delivery history of its quadrupeds is not evidence of humanoid commercial availability.

name: VLUN Technology
summary: VLUN Technology, known in Chinese as Huilun Technology, is a Guangzhou embodied robotics company incubated by GAC Group. Established as an independent operating business in 2026, it took over GAC’s humanoid robotics research and commercialization activities. It develops robot platforms, motion control, perception and core components for security inspection, industrial manufacturing and park services.

name: Weinan Impression Cognitive Technology Co., Ltd.

name: Westlake Robotics
summary: Westlake Robotics is a Hangzhou company developing embodied AI models and robot platforms. It originated from robotics and artificial intelligence research at Westlake University. Its work combines general robot behavior models with humanoid hardware, including the Titan O1 platform, and an open architecture for integrating AI with robot motion and perception.

name: Wuba Intelligent
summary: Wuba Intelligent is a Hangzhou developer and manufacturer of embodied-intelligence robots. Its official portfolio includes humanoid and quadrupedal robot platforms, together with development, manufacturing, testing and training services. The company is part of China North Industries Group and presents the Dasheng D12 as a full-size general-purpose humanoid for service and industrial applications.

name: WUJI TECH
name_zh: 深圳舞肌科技有限公司
summary: Develops directly driven robotic hands and dexterous manipulation hardware.

name: Wuxi Qianye Technology Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 无锡千烨科技有限公司
summary: Develops robotic and prosthetic hands. Its first-generation dexterous hand was reported to have received customer orders.

name: X Square Robot
summary:
X Square Robot develops embodied AI models, robot-learning tools and physical systems for manipulation. Its work includes the WALL-B world model, data-acquisition hardware and methods for connecting visual and language understanding with continuous robot control.

The company develops simulation techniques for predicting physical actions and evaluating policies, alongside interfaces for collecting human demonstrations. Its HOST research explores learning new manipulation skills from a single human video, while XRZero-G0 supports collection of motion and interaction data.

name: XBO Intelligence
summary: XBO Intelligence is a Hefei developer of inspection robots, intelligent hardware and AI software for industrial environments. Founded in 2019, it supplies robotic monitoring and maintenance systems for mining and other infrastructure. Its portfolio includes the Luban S2 dual-arm humanoid, which combines mobile inspection with physical manipulation, alongside rail-mounted and wheeled inspection robots.

name: Xiaomi
summary:
Xiaomi explores humanoid robotics through CyberOne, a research platform combining mechanical actuation, whole-body control and human interaction. The robot brings together Xiaomi-developed motion modules, depth vision and audio processing in a full-size bipedal body.

Its Mi Sense visual system supports perception of the surrounding environment, while microphones, a display and interactive software provide channels for communicating with people.

name: XPENG
summary:
XPENG develops humanoid robots alongside its electric-vehicle and physical-AI activities. Its IRON platform combines a human-shaped body, dexterous manipulation and onboard intelligence, applying the company's experience in AI, computing and hardware engineering to physical tasks beyond driving.

The next-generation IRON program focuses on coordinated movement, interaction and useful work in human environments. XPENG has described commercial-service and industrial exploration, including cooperation with Baosteel on applications such as inspection.

The official company address is in Nanshan District, Shenzhen.

name_zh: 零次方机器人(深圳)有限公司

Zero Power Robot develops embodied robot platforms under the ZERITH brand. Its public portfolio includes humanoid and wheeled dual-arm designs, combining physical mobility with manipulation for research, education, industrial work, commercial services and household assistance.

The wheeled platform uses a vertically adjustable body and long-reach arms to handle objects at different heights. Its design supports activities such as grasping, carrying and collecting interaction data for AI development.

name: ZeroErr

It develops eRob integrated rotary joint actuators, eCoder magnetic absolute encoders and dedicated power, communication and commissioning hardware for robot builders. Its products are used in collaborative, surgical, humanoid and industrial automation systems; complete robots shown in applications may belong to customer manufacturers.

name: Zeroth Robotics
summary:
Zeroth Robotics is a consumer robotics brand operated by Suzhou JoyIn Intelligent Technology. It develops robots and AI systems intended to bring embodied intelligence into everyday life, with products spanning different physical forms and use cases. Its portfolio includes the Jupiter humanoid alongside other home and companion-oriented robotic platforms.

The company's approach connects robot hardware with AI and application development, emphasizing interactions and tasks in real-world environments.

name_zh: 浙江丰立智能科技股份有限公司

Its wider business also serves vehicle, household drive and pneumatic tool applications.

name: Zhejiang Humanoid Robot Innovation Center
name_zh: 浙江人形机器人创新中心

Zhejiang Humanoid Robot Innovation Center develops complete humanoid robots and the technologies that connect high-level intelligence with motion control. Established in late 2023 by Professor Xiong Rong's team and industrial partners, the center combines research, commercialization and robotics talent development.

Its work covers full-size robot systems, stable locomotion, environmental interaction and precise manipulation. The NAVIAI portfolio and SPIRE intelligence system bring these capabilities together for industrial and commercial applications.

name: Zhicheng AI
summary: Zhicheng AI is a Hangzhou robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in March 2024. Its XR1 wheeled humanoid is presented for factory material handling and other repetitive industrial work, while its TR series addresses broader robot manipulation and mobility applications.

name: Zhongke Tanhai (Shenzhen) Marine Technology Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 中科探海(深圳)海洋科技有限责任公司
summary:
中科探海(深圳)海洋科技有限责任公司成立于2018年12月26日,董事长为刘维。公司专注于海洋智能高清探查装备的研发与生产,主要产品包括水下机器人整机、水下声学成像仪和测绘仪器等。具体产品涵盖近岸/浅海便携式水下探查机器人、中远海轻型水下探查机器人、轻型水下观察型机器人,以及一体化多波束和侧视声呐、高精度下视多波束测深仪等专业设备。此外,公司还提供基于无人船平台、拖曳平台和水下机器人平台的定制化服务,满足不同客户的成像声呐和自动驾驶单元需求。
中科探海(深圳)海洋科技有限责任公司凭借在海洋智能装备领域的技术积累,入选2025年国家级高新技术企业和省级创新型中小企业,同时获得2023年省级专精特新中小企业称号。在海底观测行业快速发展的背景下,该公司依托深圳地区的科技创新环境,专注于水下机器人及声呐设备的研发,其产品在近岸和深海探测领域具备应用潜力。随着深海探测技术向资源开发、环境监测等领域延伸,该公司在定制化服务方面的技术优势有助于把握新兴市场需求。

name: AI Wukong
summary:
AI Wukong is UBTECH's consumer humanoid companion product described in its 2025 annual report. The company associates it with its Dianling AI agent and positions it around a digital-companion experience, extending interaction beyond a conventional programmed toy.

Its primary role is consumer communication and companionship. The annual report's description should be distinguished from technical specifications for earlier Wukong robots or from UBTECH's industrial Walker platforms; it does not establish industrial manipulation capability or general-purpose physical autonomy.

The company's described applications include machine loading, assembly, material handling and equipment operation, as well as drink preparation and customer interaction in commercial spaces. summary:

Vision, sound localization and touch sensing provide inputs for responsive behavior, while bipedal movement and navigation allow the character to approach a user. name: ART-1
summary:
ART-1 is the second-generation large humanoid in ARTROBOT's development programme. The company's historical account identifies it as a platform used in public demonstrations, including the Chinese television programme Ji Zhi Guo Ren. It belongs to a broader research effort on bipedal humanoid movement and control.

This record represents that historical ART-1 generation. Capabilities and hardware specifications of later ART robots should not be assumed to apply to it without a matching model-specific source.

name: ARTROBOT Series Humanoid Robots
summary:
The ART humanoid series is ARTROBOT's family of large bipedal robots, developed across successive generations to study robot movement, intelligence and control. The company describes work on a motion-control architecture and robot operating-system development alongside its hardware programme.

The family also sits within ARTROBOT's education and engineering-training activities, which cover robot structure, control and system integration. name: Astra
summary: Astra is a legacy structured-light RGB-D camera in the Orbbec Astra family. It supplies depth, infrared and color data over USB 2.0 with onboard depth processing. Orbbec provides OpenNI wrappers for ROS and ROS 2 for this family. Marketing ended in September 2025.

name: Astra 2
summary: Astra 2 is a structured-light RGB-D camera for accurate indoor depth capture. It combines an Orbbec depth-processing ASIC, an IMU, hardware synchronization and USB 3.0 connectivity. Orbbec supports the exact model through its ROS 2 wrapper for integration into robotics perception systems.

name: Astra Embedded S
summary: Astra Embedded S is a compact structured-light RGB-D camera for close-range embedded perception. It combines an Orbbec depth ASIC, USB-C power and data and high-frame-rate depth sensing. The exact model is supported by Orbbec OpenNI SDK and its ROS wrappers. Marketing ended in September 2025.

name: Astra Mini Pro
summary: Astra Mini Pro is a bare structured-light depth module for embedded indoor vision. The long-range variant uses USB 2.0 for power and data and includes onboard Orbbec depth processing. Manufacturer-documented uses include robotic bin picking and collaborative-robot interaction.

name: Astra Mini S
summary: Astra Mini S is a compact structured-light RGB-D module for embedded indoor perception. Its 0.4–2 m working range and USB 2.0 interface support close-range service-robot sensing and industrial inspection. Orbbec has ended marketing while continuing scheduled support through May 2028.

name: Astra Mini S Pro
summary: Astra Mini S Pro is the short-range structured-light module in the Astra Mini Pro series. It supports compact embedded robotics, including bin picking and collaborative-robot interaction, using onboard depth processing and USB 2.0. Its working-distance configuration differs from the longer-range Astra Mini Pro.

name: Astra Pro Plus
summary: Astra Pro Plus is a legacy structured-light RGB-D camera in the Orbbec Astra family. It supplies depth, infrared and color data over USB 2.0 with onboard depth processing. Orbbec provides OpenNI wrappers for ROS and ROS 2 for this family. Marketing ended in September 2025.

name: Astra S
summary: Astra S is a legacy structured-light RGB-D camera in the Orbbec Astra family. It supplies depth, infrared and color data over USB 2.0 with onboard depth processing. Orbbec provides OpenNI wrappers for ROS and ROS 2 for this family. Marketing ended in September 2025.

name: Astra Stereo S U3
summary: Astra Stereo S U3 is a compact active-stereo RGB-D camera for close-range measurement and robot picking. Its onboard Orbbec ASIC produces depth data over a single USB connection. The manufacturer specifies a 0.25–2.5 m range and a bare-module form factor for embedded integration.

name: Astra+
summary: Astra+ is a legacy structured-light depth and RGB camera with USB 3.0 connectivity. It offers onboard depth processing for indoor vision applications and is explicitly supported by Orbbec's ROS 2 wrapper on its older branch. Marketing ended in May 2026.

name: Astribot S1
summary:
Astribot S1 is an AI robotics platform built around coordinated manipulation and integrated hardware-software development. Astribot calls its approach Design for AI: the physical mechanisms and control system are developed together to support learning and responsive interaction with objects and people. The product emphasizes compliant, precise movement rather than movement demonstrations alone.

S1 also serves as a development platform for embodied-intelligence research. Its workflow links data collection, model training and deployment, with teleoperation tools for recording examples of tasks.

name: AutoLife S3
summary: AutoLife S3 is a wheeled humanoid platform for indoor reception, retail, dining and supermarket tasks. A height-adjustable body, articulated arms and dexterous hands support object handling and handover, while stereo vision, LiDAR and inertial sensing support navigation in assessed environments. The manufacturer describes training manipulation skills from demonstrations and simulation. The S3 is presented for project consultation; exact-model commercial delivery status is not independently established.

It combines a head and torso, two articulated arms and interchangeable dexterous hands with a compact mobile base and folding lower-body structure. This arrangement supports work close to the floor and at elevated positions. The robot has been demonstrated in the Faway–Yuequan application laboratory for automotive component tasks. It is a publicly released development platform; broad commercial delivery is unverified. This listing refers to the original W-Bot generation.

name: Bumi

Users can control the robot through voice commands and a companion app. A quick-release battery supports recharging, while synchronized multi-robot dancing is offered through a separately purchased group-control option. Nicknamed Wednesday, it combines articulated legs, dexterous hands and a sensor-equipped head for movement, manipulation and visual-auditory interaction. The company positions it as a platform for exploring varied physical tasks.

It combines articulated arms and legs with RGB-D vision, microphones and voice interaction. CASBOT describes imitation-learning and reinforcement-learning controls for adapting its balance and gait to different surfaces.

The official specification lists a height of 1.63 metres and a standard-model weight of approximately 50 kg. Standard and EDU configurations differ: the EDU model adds development support, additional perception hardware and navigation capabilities

The published specification gives 170 cm height, 70 kg weight excluding the battery, and 5 kg payload per arm excluding the dexterous hand.

name: CyberOne
summary:

The platform uses Xiaomi’s Mi Sense depth-vision module for spatial perception, microphones for voice and environmental-sound recognition, and a curved OLED face display for interaction. It explores locomotion, perception and human–robot interaction. This record is distinct from the humanoids Xiaomi demonstrated in 2026.

Pudu describes multimodal perception, positioning and navigation, high-payload arms and hybrid control as core components. The learning system is intended to support a range of physical operations, with onboard computing connecting sensor inputs to task execution. D7's practical capabilities depend on the installed end effectors, software and industrial work

name: D800
summary: Long-range LiDAR development kit intended for professional SLAM development.

name: DaBai

It belongs to the depth-camera ecosystem used for embedded robotics; DCW, DW and Pro variants have separate records.

name: DaBai DCW
summary: DaBai DCW is an Orbbec active-stereo structured-light depth camera for service-robot navigation and obstacle avoidance. It provides onboard depth processing and USB connectivity for embedded perception. The manufacturer publishes exact-model operating-range and field-of-view specifications; these are retained separately from related DaBai variants.

name: DaBai DCW2

It provides onboard depth processing and USB connectivity for embedded perception. The manufacturer publishes exact-model operating-range and field-of-view specifications; these are retained separately from related DaBai variants.

name: DaBai DW

It provides onboard depth processing and USB connectivity for embedded perception. name: DaBai Max
summary: DaBai Max is an Orbbec active-stereo structured-light depth camera for service-robot navigation and obstacle avoidance. It provides onboard depth processing and USB connectivity for embedded perception. Its wide field of view targets nearby obstacles and environmental sensing.

name: DaBai Pro

The manufacturer documents mass-production deployment and integration with the Horizon X3 robot development platform.

name: DaCheng Alpha
summary: DaCheng Alpha is a small humanoid companion and learning robot from Chengqing Robotics. Its articulated body has a head, two arms and two legs. The manufacturer lists 13 degrees of freedom, ROS2, binocular cameras, voice interaction and mobile-app control, and positions it for learners aged 3–15. The official website presents a preorder entry, but current shipping availability is unverified.

name: Dasheng D12
summary: Dasheng D12 is Wuba Intelligent’s full-size bipedal humanoid robot for public-facing service and industrial manipulation. Its articulated arms and hands support tasks such as reception, guidance, inspection and material handling. The manufacturer presents it as a general-purpose platform with sensing and multimodal interaction. The cover shows the grey D12 configuration in the manufacturer’s conference exhibit; current product-page images show a different exterior finish. Current purchase availability and shipment volume are unverified.

name: Data Acquisition Backpack
summary: A portable UMI data acquisition terminal combining edge computing, storage and power.

name: Data Acquisition Glove Sensor

name: Data Acquisition Gripper

name: Data Capture Gloves

name: DCU08017

name: DCU17035

name: DEEP-GL

name: Dex2/5

It has 10 total degrees of freedom controlled by two actuators: one for the thumb and one shared by the remaining four fingers. The manufacturer lists a 365 g mass, RS485 communication and internal wiring intended to reduce exposed cables. Control feedback includes joint position, velocity and torque. Its 1.5 kg load figure applies to the specified grasp of a 5 cm round hard object at room temperature, rather than every manipulation task.

name: Dex3-1
summary: Dex3-1 is Unitree's three-finger dexterous hand for force-and-position-controlled manipulation and data collection with the G1 humanoid. Seven degrees of freedom are driven by six direct-drive joints and one geared joint. The official specification lists 33 pressure-sensing points, a 710 g mass and USB 2.0 communication at a stated 1 kHz rate. Joint position, velocity, torque and tactile feedback support application development. The manufacturer supplies open-source resources and a user manual, while its load and repeatability figures apply to the documented testing conditions.

name: Dex5-1
summary: Dex5-1 is Unitree's five-finger dexterous hand with 20 total degrees of freedom, including 16 active axes and four coupled finger joints. Backdrivable joints, independently replaceable fingers and lateral finger movement support manipulation and reinforcement-learning development. The official table lists a 1.1 kg mass and USB 2.0 communication, with feedback on joint motion, torque, temperature and electrical state. The base Dex5-1 does not include the pressure-sensor array listed for Dex5-1P. Manufacturer performance figures depend on the stated grasp conditions and hardware configuration.

name: Dexforce W1 Pro
summary:
Dexforce W1 Pro is a wheeled, dual-arm humanoid development platform for embodied-intelligence applications. Its configurable structure includes lifting, rotation and pitching at the torso, with alternative mobile bases, arms, grippers and dexterous hands to suit different tasks.

Stereo and wrist vision support object perception, while optional wrist force sensors provide feedback for compliant manipulation. name: DexH13 Gen 2
summary: DexH13 is PaXini's second-generation four-finger hand combining multidimensional tactile sensing with palm-mounted vision. Its 16 degrees of freedom comprise 13 active and three passive axes. The manufacturer lists 1,140 tactile sensing units and an 8 MP RGB camera for contact and object-position information. Coreless motors drive the fingers, with EtherCAT and Modbus interfaces for integration. The official page gives a 5 kg rated load and identifies industrial, logistics and service applications; stated performance and durability figures originate from PaXini's laboratory testing.

name: DexHand021 Concept

It combines six active degrees of freedom with 11 total degrees of freedom in a manufacturer-listed 790 g hand. The official specification gives a 0.8-second cycle time, 24 V operation and Modbus RTU or a proprietary RS485 protocol. Optional tactile arrays on the fingertips and palm add contact perception for adaptive gripping. The manufacturer separates a 25 N fingertip force from an 80 N five-finger gripping force and a 10 kg payload.

The exact-model specification lists a maximum hook-grip load of up to 30 kg and maximum five-finger grip force of up to 50 N. The DH116 hand is developed by Shenzhen Dexterous Drive & Control and listed by Leadshine.

name: DH116S-RW1

The manufacturer lists a maximum hook-grip load of 15 kg, maximum five-finger grip force of 50 N and IP30 protection.

Its listed dimensions are 218 × 119 × 80.5 mm and mass is 850 ±10 g. The platform is quoted by configuration through BXI’s sales team; public delivery volumes and a fixed retail price are not established. The official product page separately labels its embedded Elf 2 video as an older model, so that footage is not treated as Elf 3 evidence.

Cyborg-R01 is Cyborg Robotics' full-size bipedal humanoid platform. It sits within the company's focus on embodied robots for demanding industrial environments, where mobility, perception and physical interaction are combined to support inspection and operational work.

Cyborg identifies electricity, gas, petroleum, chemicals, mining and heavy industry as target sectors for its robotics systems. The bipedal platform provides a basis for developing tasks in spaces organized around human workers. Its actual inspection instruments, end effectors and software are application-dependent; the company

name: Fuzhi 1
summary: Fuzhi 1 is Fuwei Intelligent’s wheeled humanoid robot for industrial handling and assembly. It combines two articulated arms and dexterous hands with a folding lift structure and a mobile base. Fuwei describes RGB-D vision, visual workflow programming and model-based task planning for automotive, electronics, logistics, medical, energy and machining environments. It is publicly documented in the manufacturer’s product catalog; current delivery availability has not been independently confirmed.

name: G1
summary:
Unitree G1 is a compact humanoid platform for motion research, interaction and embodied-intelligence development. Its large joint ranges support flexible whole-body poses, while the platform's software uses imitation and reinforcement learning to develop movement skills.

Unitree offers configurations with different joint counts, computing equipment and hand options. Optional force-controlled dexterous hands combine position and force feedback for manipulation experiments. The development ecosystem supports work on perception and learned policies, with updates continuing over time. G1 specific

name: G1
summary:
G1 is AgiBot's wheeled, dual-arm platform for collecting robot-training data and developing embodied-intelligence applications. Its adjustable body spans working heights of roughly 130 to 180 cm, allowing it to reach different work surfaces while retaining a mobile base. The platform supports alternative end effectors, including dexterous hands and two-finger grippers.

The development workflow combines teleoperation, recording, data-quality tools and learned-policy deployment. AgiBot describes VR and motion-capture input options, wrist force sensing and multiple cameras for observing manipula

name: G1-D
summary:
G1-D is Unitree's humanoid manipulation and data-development platform. It combines a configurable robot body with tools for collecting demonstrations, processing and labeling recordings, reviewing data and managing training assets. Its mechanical layout provides additional reach through articulated arms, waist and a vertically adjustable structure.

The software workflow connects task allocation and collection progress with model training and inference. Unitree describes support for distributed training, custom models and common open-source frameworks. G1-D is therefore intended as an end-to-e

name: Gaia Hand 20
summary: Gaia Hand 20 is Stella-Robot's modular dexterous-hand platform for embodied AI development. The manufacturer's August 2025 launch description specifies 16 active and four passive degrees of freedom, a biomimetic thumb and replaceable joint modules built around in-house micro-actuators. The hand is listed at approximately 790 g, with support for Isaac Sim and MuJoCo workflows. Sensing varies by edition: the base model focuses on motion control, Pro adds three-dimensional fingertip force sensing, and Ultra adds full-palm tactile arrays. These editions should be distinguished when comparing capab
company_name: Shenzhen Interstellar Lightyear Technology Co., Ltd.

name: Gemini
summary: The original Gemini is an embedded active-stereo depth and color module for compact machine-vision integration. Its USB 3.0 interface and short working range support smart drones, autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance. This legacy module is distinct from the later Gemini 2 and Gemini 330 cameras.

name: Gemini 2
summary: Gemini 2 is a compact active-stereo depth camera for mobile robots, SLAM and other RGB-D applications. It provides onboard depth processing, an IMU, hardware synchronization and USB 3.0 data and power. Wide-angle depth and color sensing support perception across indoor and semi-outdoor lighting conditions.

name: Gemini 2 L
summary: Gemini 2 L is an active-stereo RGB-D camera for mobile robots, collaborative robots and 3D reconstruction. It provides onboard depth processing, USB-C power and data, an IMU and hardware synchronization. Orbbec documents navigation, obstacle avoidance and safe human-robot interaction among its applications.

name: Gemini 2 XL
summary: Gemini 2 XL is an infrared-enhanced stereo camera and OBox processing system for robot navigation, mapping and obstacle avoidance. This listing covers the current PoE-capable configuration, which also supports USB 2.0 Type-C. The OBox runs depth-enhancement algorithms for difficult lighting, reflective surfaces and small objects. The earlier non-PoE configuration has a separate lifecycle notice.

name: Gemini 215
summary: Gemini 215 is a short-range active-stereo camera built around Orbbec's MX6600 depth-processing ASIC. It supplies detailed depth, infrared and RGB data for close-range object and body-part scanning, with an IMU and multi-camera synchronization. The exact model is supported by Orbbec's ROS 2 wrapper, enabling integration into close-range robotics perception systems.

name: Gemini 305
summary: Gemini 305 is a compact USB-C stereo camera designed for mounting on robot wrists. Its 18 mm baseline and short minimum range support close-range recognition, grasping and manipulation. Global-shutter color sensors provide depth-plus-color or dual-color modes, with hardware and software synchronization for multi-camera systems.

name: Gemini 305g
summary: Gemini 305g is the GMSL2/FAKRA variant of the Gemini 305 close-range stereo camera for robot wrists. It provides RGB-D and dual-color perception while supporting flexible cabling under repeated twisting and bending. Its IP65 enclosure and retained USB-C development interface support deployment in moving robotic arms.

name: Gemini 335
summary: Gemini 335 is a compact stereo depth and RGB camera for indoor and outdoor robot perception. It combines active and passive stereo sensing with Orbbec MX6800 processing and provides point clouds, depth maps, infrared and color images over USB-C. Orbbec identifies autonomous mobile robots, delivery robots and collaborative robots among its applications. The camera supports an IMU, hardware triggering and synchronization across multiple devices.

name: Gemini 335L
summary: Gemini 335L is a USB stereo depth camera for mobile robots, robotic arms and outdoor perception. Its longer 95 mm stereo baseline supports longer-range sensing, while onboard depth processing, synchronized depth and RGB output, an IMU and IP65 protection support industrial integration.

name: Gemini 335Le
summary: Gemini 335Le is an industrial stereo depth camera for AMRs, robotic arms and forklifts. It extends the Gemini 335L platform with Gigabit Ethernet and Power over Ethernet through an M12 connector, plus an M8 interface for power, synchronization and RS-485. Its IP67 enclosure, onboard depth processing and synchronized depth, infrared, RGB and IMU streams support mobile-robot perception.

name: Gemini 335Lg
summary: Gemini 335Lg adds a GMSL2 serializer and locking FAKRA connector to the Gemini 335L stereo depth platform. It retains USB connectivity and provides depth, infrared, RGB and IMU data for autonomous mobile robots and robotic arms. Longer cable runs, hardware synchronization and an IP65 enclosure support industrial integration.

name: Gemini 336
summary: Gemini 336 is a compact stereo RGB-D camera with an IR-pass filter that limits visible-light interference. It builds on Gemini 335 depth sensing and targets reflective indoor floors, sunlight and scenes with strong shadows. USB-C connectivity, onboard depth processing, an IMU and synchronization support mobile robots and outdoor delivery robots.

name: Gemini 336L
summary: Gemini 336L is the longer-baseline, IR-pass-filter stereo camera in the Gemini 330 family. It combines long-range depth sensing with global-shutter RGB, an IMU and an IP65 enclosure. The manufacturer documents mobile-robot use over reflective floors and integration through the Orbbec SDK and synchronized multi-camera streams.

name: Gemini 338Le
summary: Gemini 338Le is an industrial stereo camera with an IR bandpass filter for reliable robot depth sensing under mixed or strong ambient light. Gigabit Ethernet, Power over Ethernet and an IP67 enclosure support factory equipment, humanoids and AMRs. It synchronizes depth, infrared, RGB and motion data for multi-camera perception.

name: Gemini 338Lg
summary: Gemini 338Lg combines a stereo depth camera and IR bandpass filter with GMSL2 and FAKRA connectivity. It targets humanoids, mobile robots and robotic arms where flexible cabling and stable data transmission during motion are important. The IP65 camera also retains USB-C for development and supports synchronized depth, infrared, RGB and IMU streams.

name: Gemini 345Lg
summary: Gemini 345Lg is a rugged stereo camera for outdoor robots, autonomous forklifts and industrial mobile platforms. It combines GMSL2/FAKRA-C connectivity with wide-field depth, color and infrared sensing. An IP67 enclosure, broad temperature range and vibration resistance support navigation and obstacle detection outdoors.

name: Gemini 435Le
summary: Gemini 435Le is an industrial stereo depth camera for long-range mobile-robot perception and logistics measurement. Gigabit Ethernet with PoE, an IP67 enclosure and scene-specific presets support navigation, obstacle detection and object dimensioning. It integrates with Orbbec SDK v2, ROS and NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

name: Gemini E
summary: Gemini E is a legacy active-stereo depth camera documented by Orbbec for robot collision avoidance and environmental perception. It provides depth and RGB sensing with onboard processing and USB connectivity. Current commercial availability and its original launch date have not been confirmed.

name: Gemini EW
summary: Gemini EW is a legacy active-stereo depth camera documented by Orbbec for robot collision avoidance and environmental perception. It provides depth and RGB sensing with onboard processing and USB connectivity. Current commercial availability and its original launch date have not been confirmed.

name: GeminiBot A1
summary: GeminiBot A1 is a wheeled humanoid robot designed by Gemini for industrial work. It combines an articulated humanoid upper body and dexterous hands with a mobile wheeled base. The manufacturer describes binocular vision, laser and visual navigation, and a control architecture that pairs industrial motion control with AI task decisions. Its industrial components are intended for sustained work and precision manipulation. The product is publicly documented; present delivery availability has not been verified.

name: GoMate dexterous hand
summary: The self-developed dexterous hand presented on GAC’s GoMate humanoid platform. GAC subsequently transferred its embodied robotics business to VLUN Technology; a standalone hand model and sales status are not disclosed.

name: GoMate Mini
summary: GoMate Mini is VLUN Technology’s fourth-generation humanoid robot for security patrols and inspection. Its wheeled and articulated lower body supports movement through park and industrial environments, while two arms support interaction and handling. The manufacturer describes perception, path planning, anomaly recognition, task execution and reporting as an integrated workflow. GAC reports real commercial deployments in its August 2026 announcement.

name: GR-1
summary:
GR-1 is Fourier's first-generation general-purpose humanoid platform for robotics development and embodied-intelligence research. Its articulated head, torso, arms, hands and legs provide up to 44 degrees of freedom, depending on configuration. Depth cameras and an inertial sensor support perception and motion control.

Fourier's documentation describes a robot approximately 1.65 metres tall and 52 kg, with a three-axis waist and six actuators in each leg. The platform supports work on walking, balance and manipulation, with a listed per-hand load of about 3 kg. Hardware, battery runtime and j

name: GR-2
summary:
GR-2 is Fourier's second-generation humanoid development platform, with upgrades to actuators, hand sensing and system integration. The manufacturer lists a height of 175 cm, a mass of 63 kg and 53 joints. Its 12-degree-of-freedom dexterous hands incorporate tactile sensor arrays to support grip adjustment and object interaction.

The design integrates power and communication wiring within the body, while different FSA actuator types address the loads at different joints. Development resources include APIs and compatibility with robotics tools such as ROS, MuJoCo and NVIDIA Isaac Lab. VR contr

name: GR-3
summary:
GR-3 is Fourier's care-oriented humanoid for interactive companionship and public-facing service research. Its design combines a soft covering, an expressive interface and coordinated body language to make interaction more approachable. The manufacturer's documentation lists a height of 165 cm, a mass of 71 kg and 55 degrees of freedom.

Fourier's Full-Sense Interaction System combines hearing, vision and touch to inform responses during social interaction. The platform also supports physical manipulation, with a stated single-arm payload of up to 3 kg. Its care positioning centers on companio

name: GRW
summary:
GRW is Fourier's wheeled, dual-arm robot for assistance, logistics and light manufacturing. Its adjustable body and paired arms support reaching, transferring and delivering objects, with a published stable dual-arm payload of up to 16 kg and a working height extending to roughly two metres.

The platform combines autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance with interchangeable end effectors. Fourier's FOCUS system supports control, communication and coordination between robots, while visual task tools help configure workflows. The manufacturer also describes battery exchange and protection f

summary: Qingbao’s Guide Robot is a humanlike service robot for guided visits, reception and question answering in cultural, educational and public-service settings. The official range includes female A1F and male A1M bodies with Basic, Standard and Flagship configurations. Basic versions use a fixed body, while Standard and Flagship versions include an intelligent mobile base for autonomous touring and reception. The cover shows the female mobile configuration; its exact Standard or Flagship trim is not identified, so no trim-specific specifications are attributed to the pictured unit. The manufacture

name: H2
summary:
Unitree H2 is a full-size humanoid platform with a humanlike head and a body approximately 180 cm tall. The manufacturer describes 31 body degrees of freedom, coordinated motion control and high-output joints intended to support dynamic whole-body movement.

The platform offers computing and dexterous-hand options for embodied-intelligence development. Perception and learned models can be combined with its physical interfaces to build manipulation and interaction applications. Unitree distinguishes rated payloads from higher peak figures in its specifications, and some equipment is optional. T

name: H2 Plus
summary:
H2 Plus is Unitree's humanoid development configuration combining a full-size body with substantial onboard computation and tactile dexterous hands. The manufacturer's presentation includes NVIDIA Jetson Thor computing, stereo head vision, wrist cameras and an inertial sensor for perception and policy execution.

The platform connects teleoperation and demonstration capture with model development through NVIDIA Isaac GR00T and related tools. Its specification distinguishes a rated arm payload of 7 kg from a higher peak figure, while battery endurance depends on activity. H2 Plus is positioned

name: H2-D
summary:
H2-D is Unitree's wheeled, dual-arm robot for mobile manipulation. Its 20-degree-of-freedom body combines force-controlled joints with omnidirectional movement, vertical lift and torso pitching, allowing the robot to position its arms within constrained workspaces.

The perception system brings together vision, lidar, ultrasonic sensing and force feedback, with audio interfaces for spoken interaction. Unitree provides development and customization interfaces for research, commercial and industrial applications. The platform's purpose is to connect mobile reach with manipulation, rather than re

name: HarmoCore-TCHL
summary: HarmoCore-TCHL is a lightweight harmonic joint family for humanoid robot integration. It combines a force sensor for force-position closed-loop control with integrated cables and connectors. This listing represents the series.

name: HC20
summary: Integrated ZR-axis linear module with force-control capability. Listed applications include electronics automation, semiconductor equipment, precision placement and medical devices.

name: HCFA five-finger dexterous hand
summary: A five-finger biomimetic robotic end effector listed in HCFA’s humanoid robotics product range, designed for flexible grasping and integrated manipulation.

name: HD-S-C
summary: HD-S-C is a extra-thin hat-type harmonic reducer family with a simplified assembly and an output main bearing. This listing represents the series.

name: HexSkin
summary: Flexible modular electronic skin for curved robot arms, torsos and other surfaces. Its distributed pressure array uses edge computation and CAN FD output for surface contact, collision and interaction sensing.

name: High-DOF Five-Finger Dexterous Hand
summary: A five-finger dexterous hand included in XSquare’s embodied robotics hardware range for manipulation and learning workflows.

name: HIVA household robot
summary:
HIVA (海娃) is Haier’s humanoid household-service robot, designed to extend smart-home automation to physical chores. Haier describes manipulation from floor level to high household surfaces, including picking up objects and cleaning tasks.

The robot is part of Haier’s wider smart-home strategy and is intended to coordinate physical work with connected appliances. It is distinct from the brand’s separate cleaning and companion robots. The official announcement describes its intended capabilities but does not provide a complete specification sheet or independently verified household-task success

name: HJ
summary: HJ is a Leadshine harmonic joint module solution family for humanoid robots, integrating motor, drive and encoder functions. This listing represents the manufacturer’s series, with electrical and mechanical options dependent on the selected configuration.

name: HJ2-110F101D24-BK-EC
summary: HJ2-110F101D24-BK-EC is a 110 mm harmonic integrated actuator from Leadshine, equipped with a brake and EtherCAT communication. The unit combines a motor, harmonic gearing, drive and encoder for robotic joint integration. The exact-model specification lists 194 N·m peak torque, 84 N·m rated torque under its stated 2000 rpm condition, a 24-bit encoder and a mass of 2600 g. Input-speed and output-speed figures must be distinguished when evaluating this geared actuator.

name: HONOR Robotics D1
summary: HONOR Robotics D1, called Flash in the Chinese campaign, is a bipedal humanoid robot built around a tall, lightweight-legged body with two articulated arms and a camera-equipped upper torso. HONOR presents it as a platform for dynamic movement and autonomous navigation, with light-strip and gesture feedback for interaction. The robot was publicly presented through the 2026 Beijing E-Town humanoid half-marathon campaign. Sporting companionship is described as a future use; commercial availability has not been established.

name: HOSON-Robot
summary: HOSON-Robot is a wheeled humanoid developed by HOSON’s wholly owned robotics subsidiary. It combines an anthropomorphic upper body and articulated arms with motion control, dexterous-hand and joint modules developed by the company. The platform is intended for loading, unloading and assembly in semiconductor and electronics environments. It was publicly launched in October 2025; a June 2026 issuer response reported that the business remained in research and development without production orders at the end of the first quarter.

name: HR
summary: Direct-drive rotary motor family integrating an optical encoder and crossed-roller bearing. A large hollow bore accommodates routing, and the load connects without an intermediate transmission.

name: HSA
summary: HSA is a industrial rotary actuator family integrating a harmonic reducer, motor, encoder and brake. It is intended for compact rotary mechanisms requiring load capacity and positioning control. This listing represents the series.

name: HSE
summary: An ultra-thin piezoresistive pressure-array sensor for palms, robot skin, grippers and other thickness-constrained surfaces. The detailed product table specifies normal-force and contact-position sensing, a 20 N range and a thickness-like size entry below 0.3 mm.

name: HSG
summary: The HSG tactile data-collection family offers an integrated glove and external fingertip sleeves. It supports robot teleoperation, research datasets and upgrades to motion-capture or IMU equipment, with wired Type-C and 2.4 GHz wireless communication.

name: HSG/HS-C-H
summary: HSG/HS-C-H is a complete hollow hat-type harmonic reducer assembly. It combines an output main bearing with a large central opening for integration. This listing represents the series.

name: HSG/HS-C-J
summary: HSG/HS-C-J is a complete hat-type harmonic reducer assembly using a shaft input connection. The integrated construction supports installation as a rotary transmission unit. This listing represents the series.

name: HSG/HS-S-C
summary: HSG/HS-S-C is a hat-type harmonic reducer family with a simplified assembly and an output main bearing. Its motor shaft couples directly to the wave generator bore. This listing represents the series.

name: HSG/HS-S-H
summary: HSG/HS-S-H is a hollow hat-type harmonic reducer family with a simplified assembly and an output main bearing. Its central opening accommodates transmission integration requirements. This listing represents the series.

name: HSM
summary: A finger-pad tactile sensor with a hollow structure that leaves space for motors, linkages or tendons. It measures normal force, contact position and contact shape for dexterous-hand integration.

name: HSP
summary: A flagship fingertip tactile sensor integrating three-axis force, contact position and contact-shape measurement for dexterous robot hands. The manufacturer specifies a 20 N range, overload protection and CAN, I2C, SPI or 485 communication options.

name: Hu-ECU
summary: Coreless motor family using an ironless cup winding. The structure is intended to reduce iron-related losses and torque ripple in compact drives.

name: Hu-GRS
summary: Integrated rotary-joint actuator family combining dual encoders, a frameless torque motor and a hollow, flat planetary reducer. The design supports compact robot-joint integration.

name: Hu-MDB
summary: Frameless torque-motor family for compact applications requiring low mass and inertia. A range of stator and rotor sizes supports integration into different actuator designs.

name: Hu-MLS
summary: Linear-joint actuator family integrating the drive, precision encoder, motor and miniature screw. HCFA identifies humanoid wrist, elbow, hip, knee and ankle joints as target applications.

name: Hu-MRS
summary: Integrated rotary-joint actuator family combining a hollow inductive encoder, frameless torque motor and harmonic reducer. It is designed for space-constrained humanoid joints.

name: Humanoid robot (2026 prototype)
summary:
Xiaomi presented humanoid robots at its 2026 Group Investor Day, documented in its first-quarter 2026 investor presentation. This catalog entry represents the newer physical robot demonstration, separate from the earlier CyberOne platform and from Xiaomi-Robotics software models.

The cited presentation does not identify a formal model name, a commercial release date or a specification sheet. “Humanoid robot (2026 prototype)” is a descriptive catalog label. Dimensions, payload, degrees of freedom and pricing remain unconfirmed for this record; specifications from CyberOne are not transferred t

name: Humanoid Robot Controller
summary: A humanoid robot controller with a 12-core Arm processor, 64 GB LPDDR5 memory and 1 TB SSD. Its published configuration supports up to six EtherCAT ports, a minimum 125 µs control cycle and 100–275 TOPS AI compute; its stated mass is 900 g.

name: Humanoid Robot Xiaqi X02
summary:
Xiaqi X02 is Digit Robotics' humanoid service platform for reception, retail guidance, exhibition commentary and business inquiries. Its interaction system combines face tracking, sound localization, spoken dialogue, expressions and body movements to communicate with visitors.

The manufacturer describes support for multiple languages and Chinese dialects, along with autonomous movement across common indoor floor types. The robot's application behavior can be configured around a venue's information and service needs. Digit's RoboEase platform provides tools for building and managing robot appl

name: Humanoid-X
summary: Humanoid-X is Heshi Thinking’s full-size biped humanoid robot. It has a lightweight body, articulated arms, hands and legs, and runs the manufacturer’s Wujie OS embodied control system. The company positions it for commercial service, inspection and household tasks, with perception, task decisions and human collaboration. Published material also describes cooperation with wheeled robot bases and cleaning modules. The robot is an announced platform; broad commercial availability remains unverified.

name: HVCM
summary: Voice-coil motor family for fast, smooth linear actuation and force control. Applications include semiconductor manufacturing, medical equipment and optical focusing.

name: I/O Adapter Board
summary: Small breakout board for eRob joint I/O, safe-torque-off and pulse/direction wiring. Its resistor configurations support STO, pulse/direction and open-collector control, and its connector can pass signals onward to another joint.

name: I0008A2
summary: I0008A2 is a E-bus expansion analog I/O module with 0 input channels and 8 output channels for industrial control systems.

name: I0016DN
summary: I0016DN is a E-bus expansion digital I/O module with 0 input channels and 16 output channels for industrial control systems.

name: I0800A2
summary: I0800A2 is a E-bus expansion analog I/O module with 8 input channels and 0 output channels for industrial control systems.

name: I1600DN
summary: I1600DN is a E-bus expansion digital I/O module with 16 input channels and 0 output channels for industrial control systems.

name: iGMK
summary: Integrated servo gearmotor family combining the drive, motor, gearbox and bus interface. It is designed for AGVs, AMRs and compact automation equipment.

name: Imprint Glove
summary: A wearable tactile-data acquisition system using separate fingertip sensors and wrist hubs. It outputs structured 3D contact-position and 3D contact-force data for multimodal training, with USB/serial connectivity and ROS, ROS2, Python and C development support.

name: Imprint X
summary: An event-driven visuotactile sensor for robot fingertips and grippers. It uses a miniature independent event camera to output raw events, a 2D displacement field and a 3D tactile-deformation point cloud. The manufacturer announced the product and opened preorders on September 7, 2026.

name: Industrial Gripper Sensor
summary: A flexible piezoresistive tactile sensor array for industrial gripper fingers, with digital output, automatic calibration and a 0–100 N detection range.

name: Industrial Humanoid Robot
summary: Spider Robot Industrial Humanoid Robot is a wheeled, dual-arm manipulation platform for flexible manufacturing. The manufacturer describes an autonomous mobile base, a lifting and tilting torso, stereo vision, force sensing and whole-body motion planning. Intended tasks include machine loading and unloading, workpiece transfer, visual sorting, pallet handling and bin transport. name: Linker Hand L20
summary: Linker Hand L20 is LinkerBot's advanced linkage-driven hand for dexterous robotic manipulation. Its 21 degrees of freedom comprise 16 active and five passive axes, combining brushless motors, precision ball screws and rigid linkages. The manufacturer positions it for tasks that require coordinated five-finger movement and controlled grasping. The official specification lists an approximately 1.2 kg mass, CAN and RS485 interfaces, and ±0.2 mm repeatability. It is a distinct model from L20 Lite and the direct-drive O-series, with its own mechanism and performance specifications.

The manufacturer describes a compact structure intended to balance load capacity with finger mobility, including precision assembly and light industrial tasks. Its published table lists an 800 g mass, CAN and RS485 communication, a 1.2-second opening or closing time and repeatability below ±0.2 mm. The specification lists an approximately 1.2 kg mass, CAN FD communication and a 0.2-second opening or closing time. It belongs to the tendon-driven branch of the Linker Hand range, so linkage- and direct-drive model specifications should not be substituted.

name: Luban S2
summary: Luban S2 is XBO Intelligence’s mobile dual-arm humanoid for inspection and manipulation. It combines an omnidirectional mobile base with a lifting column, sensor head, articulated arms and hands. The manufacturer describes obstacle avoidance, route planning and grasping tasks, with intended uses including production-line inspection, sorting, handling and security patrol. It is publicly documented in the official catalog; current delivery availability has not been verified.

name: Lumen H1
summary: Lumen H1 is HECBOT’s humanoid robot for customer reception, exhibition explanation, shopping guidance and business enquiries. Its two arms, hands and bipedal body support human-facing interaction, with voice models, custom knowledge bases, obstacle avoidance and remote operation from a controller, phone or computer. The company describes a replaceable battery and support station for transport, standby and charging. Its official history identifies the July 2025 release as a mass-production launch; current purchasing terms have not been verified.

name: Lumos LUS
summary:
Lumos LUS is the full-size bipedal humanoid family in Lumos Robotics' embodied-intelligence portfolio. It provides the human-shaped, legged branch of a broader range that also includes wheeled dual-arm, compact humanoid and wheeled-legged robots. Lumos positions this portfolio around bringing embodied AI into industrial applications.

summary:
Lumos LUS1 is an early full-size bipedal humanoid in Lumos Robotics' LUS programme. The company's development history identifies its launch as a major milestone in building the humanoid platform, preceding the later LUS2 generation.

It belongs to Lumos's broader work on embodied intelligence for physical applications. The current corporate history establishes LUS1's identity and place in the product sequence, but detailed hardware and performance specifications should come from LUS1 documentation rather than from the current LUS2 product page.

name: Lumos LUS2
summary:
Lumos LUS2 is a full-size bipedal humanoid for research, education and commercial demonstrations. Its modular, open architecture combines natural straight-leg walking with articulated arms, environmental perception and support for secondary development. Lumos identifies navigation, object handling and human-robot interaction as intended areas of use.

name: Mercury X1

It is listed in the manufacturer’s commercial catalog with dedicated support documentation.

name: PHYBOT M1
summary:
PHYBOT M1 is a full-size humanoid combining the company's own actuation, control and power systems with learned movement policies. Its architecture is intended for research and for exploring physical work in production, logistics and specialized environments. Reinforcement and imitation learning are part of the manufacturer's described control approach.

The current product page lists more than 32 degrees of freedom, excluding configurable dexterous hands, and a dual-battery arrangement that supports replacing one battery while the other remains installed. PHYBOT identifies its published perfo

name: Physis 157g
summary: Physis 157g is a compact global-shutter RGB camera for robot perception. It shares the Physis imaging architecture, synchronization framework and software design, allowing additional robot viewpoints to use a common timing and imaging reference. Its GMSL2 connection and IP67 enclosure support integration into humanoids and collaborative robots.

name: Physis 257g
summary: Physis 257g is a passive RGB stereo camera for humanoid robots and collaborative arms. A 63 mm human-eye baseline, synchronized global-shutter color streams, an IMU and Orbbec AI depth processing provide multimodal perception through GMSL2. The IP67 camera supports indoor and outdoor operation and NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

name: PJ
summary: PJ is a Leadshine planetary joint module solution family for humanoid robots, integrating motor, drive and encoder functions. This listing represents the manufacturer’s series, with electrical and mechanical options dependent on the selected configuration.

name: PJ3-97EC140
summary: PJ3-97EC140 is a planetary integrated actuator from Leadshine with EtherCAT communication for robotic joints. It has a 22:1 gear ratio and a listed rated output torque of 44 N·m at 80 rpm, with 140 N·m instantaneous maximum torque. The manufacturer specifies a 24–48 VDC supply, IP54 protection and a mass of 1200 g.

name: PL-Universe ProWhite Robot
summary:
ProWhite is PL-Universe’s industrial embodied robot, described by the manufacturer as a humanoid platform with modular end effectors. It targets flexible operations in settings such as consumer-electronics and automotive manufacturing.

The company combines the robot with its SDPAA architecture and application services for adapting workflows, handling material and automating loading. PL-Universe reports that the original ProWhite has been mass-produced and delivered. This record represents that original platform; it is kept separate from the existing ProWhite 2.0 record.

name: PM805-E1
summary: Industrial active-stereo depth camera with dual infrared lasers, RGB and point-cloud output. Gigabit Ethernet, PoE+ or 24 V power, hardware triggering and an IP54 housing support fixed industrial vision integration.

name: PM806-E1
summary: Industrial active-stereo camera with a wide-baseline housing and Ethernet interface. It delivers depth and color information for the P-series robot picking and material-handling applications.

name: PMD02-E1
summary: PMD02-E1 is a P-series industrial 3D camera using stereo dot-pattern structured light. It produces depth, color and infrared images and point clouds through Gigabit Ethernet, with support for Linux, Windows, ROS and the Camport SDK. Percipio positions the P series for robot pick-and-place work such as palletizing and loading. The camera is a perception component for integration into industrial robotic systems.

name: PMD03-E1
summary: Long-baseline structured-light 3D camera for wide-field, long-range sensing in palletizing, depalletizing and random sorting. It outputs depth and color data over Gigabit Ethernet.

name: Primal M1
summary: Primal M1 is HokMind’s full-body biomimetic robot platform for digital characters, entertainment, brand presentation and immersive experiences. It combines a humanlike body and face with drive and interaction systems intended to produce facial expressions, poses and upper-body motion. Characters and interactive content can be customized for a venue or brand. It is a publicly announced prototype platform; autonomous walking and broad commercial delivery have not been verified. The cover is an official promotional rendering.

name: PRO S-GL
summary: Mech-Eye industrial 3D camera for short- to medium-range bin picking and assembly. It supplies depth data over Gigabit Ethernet and is supported by the Mech-Mind vision software ecosystem for robotic perception.

name: Pro20A
summary: A higher-dexterity robotic hand listed by TheoHand with 20 degrees of freedom for manipulation applications.

name: PS800-E1
summary: Structured-light 3D camera with an embedded vision processor for small, static objects. It produces depth and color information for object recognition, classification and localization.

name: PS801-E1
summary: Discontinued industrial active-stereo RGB-D camera for detailed 3D detection of stationary objects. It combines a 5-megapixel RGB sensor, infrared floodlights, hardware triggering and an IP67 housing; the E1 and N-E1 variants have different measurement performance.

name: PS801-N-E1
summary: Near-range variant of the PS801 active-stereo RGB-D camera series for detailed 3D detection of stationary objects. It uses the documented common PS801 housing and imaging hardware, with its own narrower measurement range and field of view.

name: PS802-E1
summary: Active-stereo 3D camera with an embedded processor for recognition and classification of static objects. Its Ethernet interface exposes depth and color information for machine-vision integration.

name: PsiBot_V1
summary:
PsiBot V1 is an embodied-robot platform with articulated manipulation and a sensor arrangement intended to observe its surrounding workspace. PsiBot's product specification lists four RGB-D cameras, three fisheye cameras and a Thor computing platform, alongside two-degree-of-freedom waist and neck assemblies.

The manufacturer states a standing height below 1.80 metres, a single-arm reach of 683 mm and battery life exceeding eight hours. Cable charging and automatic return charging are listed options. These figures are manufacturer specifications; the published page does not establish task-spe

name: PUDU D9

summary:
PUDU D9 is Pudu Robotics' first full-size bipedal humanoid, introduced by Pudu X-Lab in December 2024. The launch specification describes a robot 170 cm tall and 65 kg, with 42 degrees of freedom and DH11 dexterous hands.

Its demonstrations combined walking, obstacle negotiation and slope climbing with dual-hand operation. One example used the robot to operate Pudu's SH1 floor-cleaning equipment, illustrating interaction with an existing tool. D9 develops the company's embodied-intelligence approach in a walking platform, with commercial task capability dependent on the trained software, sens

name: Pulsar ME450
summary: Pulsar ME450 is a dToF 3D LiDAR for robot navigation and obstacle avoidance. It combines MEMS pitch scanning with motorized azimuth control and supports repetitive and non-repetitive scanning patterns. Configurable field of view and rotation speed let one sensor serve different mobile-robot sensing requirements, with IP67 protection for demanding environments.

name: Pulsar MH24
summary: Pulsar MH24 is a compact 24-channel dToF LiDAR for robot navigation, mapping and obstacle avoidance. It provides a 360-degree horizontal scan, a built-in six-axis IMU and RS485 data connection. Its low-power design, IP6K6 protection and outdoor-light tolerance support lawnmowers, AMRs, delivery and service robots.

name: Pulsar SL450
summary: Pulsar SL450 is a single-line dToF LiDAR for robot positioning, navigation and environmental scanning. Its rotating-mirror optical system scans a 270-degree horizontal region with a range up to 45 metres. The compact IP65 sensor supports warehouse AMRs, autonomous forklifts and service robots.

name: PX-FOOTRIX
summary: PX-FOOTRIX is a Hall-array tactile sensor for the soles of bipedal robots. It measures distributed three-dimensional contact force and six-dimensional force/torque to support gait control and terrain response. Left-foot and right-foot options are separately selectable under the same model name. SPI is standard; UART, USB and RS485 require an optional adapter, while I2C and CAN FD require customization. The cover illustrates both handedness alternatives, not a bundled pair.

name: Q5
summary:
Q5 is RobotEra’s wheeled humanoid platform for interactive service and research. The manufacturer’s CES 2026 announcement specifies 44 degrees of freedom and describes coordinated movements such as lowering the body to pick up objects.

RobotEra demonstrated visitor interaction and gift delivery at CES. Its wheeled design is intended for indoor commercial service environments as well as research. These demonstrations establish the model and intended use; they do not by themselves verify unattended service reliability or quantify autonomy.

name: Qianye first-generation dexterous hand
summary: A first-generation robotic hand developed by Wuxi Qianye. A manufacturer interview reports development in 2024 and customer orders, while the design patent identifies robotic and prosthetic grasping applications.

name: Qinglong(humanoid)
summary:
Qinglong is OpenLoong's public humanoid reference platform, developed to support a shared robotics research and engineering ecosystem. The project releases design information for the hardware together with control frameworks, whole-body dynamics software, technical documentation and data collected from the physical robot.

This combination lets developers study the system, reuse components and build their own experiments across simulation and hardware. OpenLoong also provides related datasets and the Gewu simulation platform for modeling, environment construction and data generation. Qinglong

name: QJJ001
summary: QJJ001 is the published cleaning-robot controller PCBA configuration from Live Electronics. The manufacturer lists Wi-Fi/Bluetooth communication, automatic route planning and automatic charging. It is supplied within a custom board-development and integration offering; broad optional feature lists are not assumed to be the delivered configuration.

name: Quad-Eye Matrix Sensor
summary: Four-module vision and depth perception assembly for outdoor robots, used in the ANTHBOT Genie series for boundary-free lawn navigation.

name: Quadruped Robot Controller
summary: A dedicated controller for quadruped robots, integrating an eight-core Arm processor, 6 TOPS AI compute and a real-time operating system. It provides Ethernet, wireless connectivity and serial interfaces for robot peripherals.

name: QUANTA X2
summary:
Quanta X2 (量子2号) is X Square Robot's wheeled humanoid manipulation platform. It combines a mobile base, articulated torso and dual arms with the company's WALL-A model, aiming to connect visual perception, task understanding and action control in one system. Proposed applications include research, household services, commercial cleaning and logistics sorting.

name: R1
summary:
R1 is a Galaxea Dynamics dual-arm mobile manipulation platform in the R1 humanoid family. It combines an articulated upper body with a wheeled base, supporting manipulation research, data collection and task development.

The official family specification distinguishes arm, torso and chassis configurations for R1, R1 Pro and R1 Lite. Teleoperation and onboard computing support experimentation with embodied AI. Measurements in this record are tied to the named model and configuration; specifications for an individual A1 arm are not treated as those of the complete robot.

name: R1
summary:
Unitree R1 is a lightweight humanoid family for movement, interaction and developer experimentation. The manufacturer describes a body up to approximately 123 cm tall and around 29 kg, with joint counts varying by edition. Its compact structure is intended to simplify handling and maintenance.

The platform combines visual and spoken interaction with whole-body motion. Development configurations expose joint and sensor interfaces and support common simulation environments, helping users transfer algorithms from virtual tests to physical hardware. The official family specification distinguishes arm, torso and chassis configurations for R1, R1 Pro and R1 Lite. Teleoperation and onboard computing support experimentation with embodied AI. name: R1-D

The platform provides camera, audio and robot-control interfaces for building applications. Its vision module exposes RGB and depth information, while microphones and speakers support spoken interaction. End interfaces allow different grippers or other tools to be fitted. name: R2
summary:
R2 is Robbyant’s wheeled humanoid platform for indoor manipulation. It combines an omnidirectional base with articulated arms, joint-torque feedback and six-axis end-effector force sensing. Robbyant describes a reach from floor level to two metres and a rated 6 kg payload per arm.

The design includes joint brakes, compliant grasping and swappable dual batteries. The manufacturer reports approximately four hours of runtime, with dock charging offered as an option. The official product page marks R2 as coming soon and positions it for validating robot models and integrated task solutions in rea

name: RB100
summary: Integrated servo-wheel family for mobile equipment. The compact assembly combines traction components to support load-bearing wheel-drive applications.

name: RB200
summary: Integrated planetary-joint module family for robot actuation. VEICHI describes low backdrive resistance, configurable construction and thermal management.

name: RB300
summary: Integrated servo-drive and motor family with a compact structure. The combined assembly supports networked machine motion with reduced installation complexity.

name: RDK S100
summary: RDK S100 is a development kit for robot perception and real-time control. It combines six Cortex-A78AE CPU cores, an 80 TOPS BPU, 12 GB of LPDDR5 memory and four Cortex-R52+ real-time MCU cores. Camera interfaces, USB, Ethernet, CAN and MCU expansion support multi-sensor robot prototypes. This entry covers the S100 model; the higher-performance S100P is a separate model.

name: RDK S600
summary: RDK S600 is a development kit for embodied AI and advanced robot computing. It combines an 18-core Cortex-A78AE CPU, a 560 TOPS BPU and six Cortex-R52+ real-time MCU cores. Multi-camera inputs, high-speed networking, USB, CAN and MCU expansion support perception, edge large-model inference and control integration. The kit is distinct from the bare RDK S600 Module, whose external ports depend on a carrier design.

name: RDK X3
summary: RDK X3 is an Arm-based single-board computer for robot development and edge AI prototyping. Its quad-core Cortex-A53 processor and BPU support vision inference, while camera, USB, Ethernet and general-purpose I/O connections integrate sensors and control hardware. D-Robotics provides operating-system images, development tools and TogetheROS.Bot middleware for evaluating robot applications. Memory options and hardware revisions are documented within this model family.

name: RDK X3 Module
summary: RDK X3 Module is a compact compute module for embedded robot products and custom carrier designs. It integrates a Sunrise 3 AI processor, a quad-core Cortex-A53 CPU and up to 5 TOPS of AI processing in a 55 × 40 mm form factor compatible with Raspberry Pi CM4. D-Robotics offers memory, eMMC and wireless configurations. Native camera, display, USB, Ethernet and GPIO resources are exposed through the module interface; external connectors depend on the carrier board.

name: RDK X5
summary: RDK X5 is a single-board development platform for robotics and edge AI. It combines an Arm Cortex-A55 CPU with a dedicated BPU and supports camera, network and control connections through MIPI CSI, USB, Gigabit Ethernet, CAN FD and general-purpose I/O. D-Robotics offers different memory configurations and provides Ubuntu support, model-deployment tools and TogetheROS.Bot middleware to help developers build and evaluate robot prototypes. The board serves as the onboard computing and integration platform for sensing, AI inference and robot application development.

name: Research-grade Data Collector

Booster T2 is a humanoid development platform for embodied-intelligence research and general robotics applications. The manufacturer lists a body approximately 140 cm tall and 42 kg, with 31 degrees of freedom distributed across the legs, seven-axis arms, waist and head. This layout supports coordinated whole-body movement and manipulation experiments.

name: Tacta
summary: An ultrathin tactile sensing and computation device for dexterous hands. Its high-density array uses multidimensional spatial encoding to measure contact location and normal, tangential and dynamic force.

name: Tansuo D1
summary:
Tansuo D1 (探索D1) is a full-size electrically actuated humanoid developed by CETC’s 21st Research Institute and CETC Robotics. CETC announced it at the November 2025 small-motor exhibition in Shanghai. Its developers use physical-model-based perception and motion control.

CETC describes protected joints and wiring, pressure-sensitive fingers, autonomous charging, obstacle avoidance and recovery after falling. The robot targets logistics, manufacturing and specialized operations. Published dimensions and mobility limits are manufacturer-reported specifications rather than independently verified

TARS is a next-generation humanoid robot by Chinese startup TARS Robotics.

name: TDM020
summary:
TDM020 is TOPSTAR's humanoid dual-arm robot in the company's Tuoxingji embodied-intelligence product range. It is positioned for industrial handling, sorting and inspection tasks that benefit from a two-arm arrangement. TOPSTAR lists it alongside a wheeled humanoid and a separate human-like robotic arm, indicating distinct integration formats within the range.
