summary:
Source: https://www.atomrobot.com/product/163?name=%27%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E4%B8%AD%E5%BF%83%27

Atom Robotics presented its Tianbing No. 1 (天兵一号) ATOM01 embodied intelligent robot and Tianxun (天巡) AR-W1 wheeled intelligent inspection robot.

name: Tianjiang No. 1
summary:
Tianjiang No. 1, designated AR-H2, is Atomrobot's wheeled humanoid manipulation platform. It combines two seven-axis, force-controlled arms with a lifting body and mobile chassis. The vertical adjustment allows the arms to work at different heights, while rotation in place helps the robot reposition between workstations.

Its perception system combines laser-based mapping with vision and proximity sensing for navigation and interaction with its surroundings. The manufacturer describes interchangeable two-finger grippers and five-finger hands, allowing different tooling for different objects. T

Source: https://www.eir.com.cn/

Tianxingzhe No. 2 (天行者2号), a full-size humanoid robot.

name: Tianzhen Z1
summary: Tianzhen Z1 is TLIBOT’s full-size bipedal humanoid robot. Its modular skeleton supports customized exterior designs and adaptations for different industries. The manufacturer emphasizes expressive upper-body motion through articulated neck, waist and shoulders, including shrugging and humanlike interaction. The official WRC 2026 product page establishes this named generation; current serial production and delivery terms are not verified.

name: Tien Kung 3.0
summary:
TienKung 3.0 is a general-purpose humanoid platform from X-Humanoid, the Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center. It combines the center's high-power joint hardware with whole-body control and its embodied-intelligence system to coordinate movement, perception and manipulation.

The manufacturer's application examples include opening doors, reading instruments during inspections, picking and handling objects, and moving through changing surroundings. Spoken question answering and guided interaction add a service-facing layer to the physical platform. These examples describe the types of tasks

name: Tien Kung Omni
summary:
TienKung Omni is X-Humanoid's compact, open development platform for embodied-intelligence research, education and robotics competitions. It exposes interfaces for joint sensing, system functions and motion control so developers can build their own behaviors rather than relying only on preconfigured demonstrations.

The range includes a flagship configuration with 31 degrees of freedom and options for dexterous hands, teleoperation and data-collection equipment. Depth sensing, lidar and inertial measurements support perception and movement development. X-Humanoid describes applications spannin

name: Titan O1
summary: Titan O1 is Westlake Robotics’ humanoid robot platform, presented as a physical platform for embodied AI models. It combines an articulated humanoid body with an open architecture and the company’s robot behavior models. The official catalog describes integration of motion control, perception and embodied AI. The primary image retains the manufacturer’s genuine upper-body product render; commercial shipping availability is unverified.

name: TL430-E1
summary: Indirect time-of-flight depth camera with infrared and point-cloud output, an IP67 aluminum housing, Gigabit Ethernet and hardware triggering. It supports several depth resolutions and quality modes for industrial sensing.

name: TL460-S1-E1
summary: Indirect time-of-flight RGB-D camera with two infrared lasers and an IP67 aluminum housing. Gigabit Ethernet, PoE, hardware triggering and selectable depth-quality modes support industrial depth acquisition.

name: TM260-E1
summary: Discontinued compact direct time-of-flight camera for AGV/AMR obstacle avoidance, 3D positioning and recognition. It uses one M12 connector for 100M Ethernet, power and hardware-trigger connections.

name: TM260-E2
summary: Discontinued compact direct time-of-flight camera for AGV/AMR obstacle avoidance and depth sensing. It outputs depth, infrared and point clouds through 100M Ethernet and uses separate power, Ethernet and trigger connections.

name: TM262-E1
summary: Compact direct time-of-flight depth camera with a wide field of view and sunlight resistance. It is intended for indoor and outdoor depth sensing, including mobile-robot collision avoidance.

name: TM265-E1
summary: Compact direct time-of-flight depth camera for mobile-robot navigation and obstacle avoidance. Its wide field of view and ambient-light resistance support industrial and logistics sensing.

name: TM421-E1
summary: Compact indirect time-of-flight depth camera with RGB, infrared and point-cloud output. It combines Gigabit Ethernet, 24 V power, hardware triggering and an IP65 aluminum housing for integrated depth sensing.

name: TM461-E2
summary: Indirect time-of-flight RGB-D camera for obstacle detection, navigation and object dimensioning. It provides Gigabit Ethernet and selectable ToF channels; its measurement range depends on channel and depth-quality settings.

name: TOF IDC3224R_LD01
summary: 3D time-of-flight depth camera co-developed with Texas Instruments for service-robot mapping, obstacle detection and recognition applications.

name: TOF IDC8060R_LD02
summary: 3D time-of-flight depth camera designed for high-frame-rate obstacle sensing and robot navigation, with recognition and AR/VR applications.

summary:
TORA-DOUBLE ONE is PaXini's lightweight humanoid platform built around visual and tactile intelligence. Its control stack combines the company's OmniVTLA model with PX-Core vision-and-touch control, supported by an NVIDIA AGX Orin computing platform.

The mechanical design emphasizes folding, reduced weight and passage through constrained spaces. PaXini describes omnidirectional movement and configurable chassis arrangements for different terrain requirements. This connects mobile positioning with manipulation research and task development. The platform's distinctive emphasis is using touch al

name: TORA-ONE
summary:
TORA-ONE is PaXini's wheeled humanoid manipulation platform combining visual perception with multidimensional tactile sensing. Its dexterous-hand approach uses information about contact as well as object appearance, supporting controlled grasping and interaction with items whose shape or placement can vary.

The product presentation describes object-pose recognition, positioning and force-control techniques as core capabilities. The wheeled configuration supplies mobility for moving between task locations, while the arms and hands carry out manipulation. TORA-ONE is intended as a platform for

name: TRIFORCE SENSOR (finger pad)
summary: A three-axis tactile sensor shaped for the finger pad of a dexterous hand. It provides normal and tangential force measurement, with two listed size configurations and configurable UART communication.

name: TRIFORCE SENSOR (fingertip)
summary: A compact fingertip tactile sensor providing three-axis force feedback through self-decoupling algorithms for robotic manipulation and automation. The manufacturer lists two physical size configurations and configurable UART communication.

name: TRM
summary: TRM is a high-voltage integrated joint module family for collaborative robots, designed to reduce joint package size and weight. This listing represents the series.

name: TRON 2
summary:
TRON 2 is LimX Dynamics' modular embodied-robot platform. A common system can be configured for dual-arm manipulation, bipedal movement or wheeled-leg operation, allowing researchers to explore different physical arrangements without starting from a completely separate platform.

LimX provides development tools, model and data examples, and documentation for teleoperation, control and deployment. Its dual-arm configuration targets vision-language-action research and manipulation, while the legged configurations support work on terrain adaptation and mobility. Accessories and configuration dete

name: TSMX
summary: Integrated closed-loop stepper-servo motor family combining motor, encoder and motion control. Pulse, analog and industrial bus variants support distributed motion systems.

name: TX01
summary:
TX01 is TengenX AI's wheeled, dual-arm robot for industrial embodied-intelligence applications. Its published configuration has 27 degrees of freedom, an adjustable working height of 125 to 175 cm and a four-wheel omnidirectional base. The manufacturer distinguishes a rated single-arm payload of 6 kg from a higher maximum load.

The robot combines vision-language-action and world-model approaches for perception, planning, prediction and control. TengenX describes application validation in sectors including batteries and new energy. Dual hot-swappable batteries support extended operating workfl

name: UHP-140-GL
summary: Mech-Eye industrial 3D camera for precision close-range inspection. It supplies depth data over Gigabit Ethernet and is supported by the Mech-Mind vision software ecosystem for robotic perception.

name: ULTRA M-GL
summary: Mech-Eye industrial 3D camera for detailed medium-range industrial perception. It supplies depth data over Gigabit Ethernet and is supported by the Mech-Mind vision software ecosystem for robotic perception.

name: Ultra Magnus
summary: Ultra Magnus, also called Tongtianxiao, is a humanoid robot prototype released by APLUX at CES 2025. It combines APLUX's fusion operating system and on-device AI with Ti5 Robot joint modules and motion-control algorithms, using Qualcomm QCS8550 computing. The partners describe voice interaction, visual perception and task planning for commercial service settings. The pictured CES prototype has two articulated arms, hands and a bipedal lower body. General commercial availability has not been verified.

name: Unitree H1
summary:
H1 is Unitree's first full-size general-purpose humanoid platform. Its development emphasizes dynamic bipedal movement, using high-output joints and coordinated control to support walking, running and balance experiments. Lidar and depth-camera inputs provide spatial information for perception and navigation development.

name: Unitree H1-2
summary:
H1-2 is the updated version of Unitree's full-size H1 humanoid platform. Its configuration expands articulation, including six degrees of freedom in each leg and seven in each arm, supporting more flexible movement and manipulation development.

The manufacturer positions the revision around improvements in agility, load handling and endurance, with depth and lidar sensing supporting environmental perception. It remains a development platform whose applications depend on the attached hands, computing configuration and control software. H1-2 specifications should be assessed separately from the

name: USD01-2550
summary: Compact structured-light 3D camera for close-range identification, positioning and assembly guidance. HDR support and detailed point-cloud imaging suit eye-in-hand industrial vision.

name: VB1
summary:
VB1 is a VMR/VersaBot wheeled humanoid platform within Lanxin Robotics’ product portfolio. The official catalog describes industrial and office applications that combine mobile navigation, object handling and human interaction.

The platform uses articulated arms with electric grippers and depth sensing. The manufacturer describes SLAM navigation, camera-assisted alignment, obstacle detection and charging support. VB1 and VB1-I have separate chassis, working-height and runtime configurations; their specifications should be compared by exact model.

name: VB1-I
summary:
VB1-I is a VMR/VersaBot wheeled humanoid platform within Lanxin Robotics’ product portfolio. The official catalog describes industrial and office applications that combine mobile navigation, object handling and human interaction.

The platform uses articulated arms with electric grippers and depth sensing. The manufacturer describes SLAM navigation, camera-assisted alignment, obstacle detection and charging support. VB1 and VB1-I have separate chassis, working-height and runtime configurations; their specifications should be compared by exact model.

name: VB2
summary:
VB2 is a wheeled humanoid from VMR (Weimaier), a wholly owned subsidiary of Lanxin Robotics. It combines seven-joint arms, five-finger hands and an omnidirectional wheeled base for indoor mobile manipulation. The manufacturer specifies a 0.2–2 m working-height range, 5 kg load per arm and 760 mm arm reach.

SLAM navigation, panoramic RGB-D perception and autonomous obstacle avoidance support movement through workspaces. VMR lists four to six hours of runtime and a maximum base speed of 1.2 m/s. These are manufacturer specifications; task duration depends on operating conditions.

name: Vbot Humanoid Robot
summary: Vbot Humanoid Robot is the publicly presented humanoid prototype program from Vita Dynamics. The manufacturer describes perception, language interaction, task planning and mobile manipulation for household assistance. The cover is its official bipedal concept rendering, with two arms, hands and articulated legs. No formal alphanumeric model identifier or verified commercial delivery is established; planned capabilities should not be read as independently tested performance.

name: VC-12.7
summary: VC-12.7 is a voice-coil motor in the DINGS Voice-coil motors portfolio. The manufacturer lists continuous force 0.4 N, peak force 3.2 N.

name: ViHero intelligent dexterous hand
summary: A human-scale robotic hand developed by ViHero with 16 independently moving joints, current-feedback force control and visual localization markers. It is designed to work with the company’s stereo vision system.

name: Visuotactile Smart Gripper
summary: A robotic end effector with two optical tactile sensors and closed-loop position, speed and force control.

name: VK
summary: Frameless motor family for integration into compact motion assemblies. The stator and rotor design emphasizes power density, thermal performance and installation flexibility.

summary: Fringe/phase structured-light 3D camera for close-range industrial and robotic perception. It uses blue illumination to produce detailed point clouds through a Gigabit Ethernet interface.

name: VMD02-5011
summary: Fringe/phase structured-light 3D camera for industrial depth sensing at short working distances. Blue illumination and a Gigabit Ethernet interface support point-cloud integration.

name: VMD03-8521(C)
summary: Fringe/phase structured-light 3D camera for longer-range industrial and robotic perception. Its wide-baseline housing supports depth and point-cloud acquisition; the catalog denotes an optional C configuration.

name: VZRE3-50
summary: VZRE3-50 is a Vieta combined linear/rotary actuator for automated handling and machine or robotic end-effector integration. Communication and mechanical customizations remain options of the named base model unless a separate model is explicitly identified.

name: W1
summary:
NEXFORM W1 is a wheeled dual-arm robot for service workflows, embodied-AI research and data collection. A height-adjustable torso brings its arms to different working levels, while perception hardware and a mobile base support navigation and interaction. The manufacturer describes autonomous operation and several forms of teleoperation, including VR and software control.

Its development environment supports collecting demonstrations, training models and deploying control policies, with SDK, ROS and simulation integration. W1 is offered in several configurations with different arm, compute, po

name: WA100
summary: An underwater five-finger hand developed by Heyman for submerged manipulation and water-exposed service tasks. Civil and deep-sea engineering configurations should not be treated as identical.

name: Walker 2
summary:
Walker 2 is the second generation of UBTECH's Walker humanoid programme, introduced in 2019 according to the company's historical timeline. It represents an early stage in the development of UBTECH's larger humanoid systems, before later Walker X and industrial Walker variants.

The company records public demonstrations during that period, including a Spring Festival Gala performance involving six Walker robots. This record should be treated as a historical generation: later payload, battery-management and factory-deployment claims require their own matching model evidence.

name: Walker C
name_zh: Walker C 商用服务人形机器人
summary:
Walker C is UBTECH's full-size bipedal service humanoid for guided tours and interaction in exhibition halls and office environments. Its embodied-interaction model supports multilingual conversation, proactive greetings and answers based on a customized information database.

U-SLAM navigation and obstacle perception allow the robot to follow configured tour routes while adapting to nearby movement. Whole-body control combines walking with gestures and presentation behavior. UBTECH associates the platform with the China Pavilion at Expo 2025, illustrating its intended public-facing role. The

name: Walker C1
name_zh: Walker C1 商用服务人形机器人
summary:
Walker C1 is UBTECH's full-size humanoid service platform for commercial and public-facing applications. It combines an articulated body with multimodal interaction and surrounding perception, allowing movement and gestures to accompany communication with visitors.

A built-in motion library supports predefined behaviors, while standard interfaces and an SDK allow application developers to customize movements and integrate services. UBTECH positions the platform for a range of human-oriented environments and interactive events. Its practical role depends on the installed application, site conf

name: Walker S
name_zh: Walker S 工业人形机器人
summary:
Walker S is UBTECH's industrial humanoid for coordinated work on manufacturing lines. Its approximately 1.7-metre body combines force-feedback joints, whole-body manipulation and a perception system intended to support operation around production equipment and people.

The platform integrates U-SLAM and semantic navigation with task decision-making, hand-eye coordination and UBTECH's ROSA operating environment. Control options include graphical tools, teleoperation and connections to industrial systems. These components support development of inspection and handling workflows within existing f

name: Walker S and Walker S1
summary:
Walker S and Walker S1 represent successive UBTECH industrial humanoid platforms. Both combine human-scale mobility with perception and manipulation for work in manufacturing environments. Their development centers on integrating the robot into production workflows rather than treating locomotion as a standalone demonstration.

The platform targets variable manufacturing environments where a robot must move, perceive objects and manipulate them as part of a workflow. name: Walker S2
name_zh: Walker S2 新一代工业人形机器人
summary:
Walker S2 is UBTECH's industrial humanoid with autonomous battery exchange as a central operating feature. Its dual-battery system allows the robot to coordinate a replacement while maintaining power, using both arms to perform the exchange at a compatible station. The manufacturer reports a swap procedure of about three minutes.

name: Walker X
name_zh: Walker X 大型仿人服务机��人
summary:
Walker X is UBTECH's commercial-service humanoid combining bipedal movement, spoken interaction and object manipulation. The manufacturer lists a height of 130 cm, a mass of 63 kg and 41 servo joints, with a curved-screen facial interface and removable battery.

Its capabilities bring together U-SLAM navigation, path planning, visual perception and hand-eye coordination. Whole-body control supports balance and responses to disturbances, while articulated arms and hands allow interaction with objects. Walker X is positioned for intelligent service demonstrations and application development acro

name: Wanda 2.0
summary: Wanda 2.0 is a wheeled humanoid robot developed by UniX AI for home and commercial service tasks. It combines a vertically adjustable torso, two articulated arms and adaptive two-finger grippers with a differential-drive base. The manufacturer describes binocular and RGB-D cameras, lidar and ultrasonic sensing, and lists applications including home service, office cleaning and reception. The manufacturer has announced a Wanda 2.0 mass-production plan; current delivery availability is unverified.

name: Wheeled Dual-arm Humanoid Robot
summary: Reconova’s Wheeled Dual-arm Humanoid Robot is designed to transfer irregular baggage such as backpacks and handbags. It combines a mobile base, an articulated upper body and two grippers with visual perception and coordinated manipulation. Reconova describes recognition, grasping, transport and placement as the intended workflow, complementing its Xiaoyi robot for regular suitcases. The platform was exhibited in 2026; verified commercial delivery status is unavailable.

name: Wheeled Humanoid Robot
summary:
Cyborg-W01 is the wheeled humanoid member of Cyborg Robotics' platform range. It combines mobile positioning with an upper-body robot configuration for developing physical tasks and inspection workflows. The wheeled design provides an alternative to the company's bipedal platform for suitable operating surfaces.

The manufacturer focuses on industrial sectors including energy, chemicals, mining and heavy manufacturing, where robots can be configured with perception and inspection equipment for particular jobs. It also identifies research, education and data collection as uses for its systems.

name: WristCam
summary: WristCam is a wrist-worn camera and inertial-sensing module for collecting close-range human interaction data. It complements first-person or global views with detailed hand-object and tool-object observations for robot learning and fine manipulation training. The module combines a fisheye camera, synchronized IMU data and wireless connectivity.

name: Wuji Glove
summary: Wuji Glove is a human-hand data-capture glove for robotic teleoperation, tactile research and human-robot interaction. A 24 × 31 pressure matrix contains 526 active sensing points and outputs tactile data at 120 FPS. Five fingertip electromagnetic receivers track position and orientation at 120 Hz, while a six-axis IMU samples at 800 Hz. The manufacturer specifies 67.5 g net glove mass and 192.6 g including cables. USB-C supplies 5 V / 1 A, and an adapter provides RJ45 100BASE-TX networking. EMF tracking is sensitive to metal and ferromagnetic materials. Python/C SDK and CLI tools support data

name: Wuji Hand
summary: A five-finger hand with 20 actively driven joints, four per finger. It uses rotary direct-drive joints, FOC motor control and USB communication for robotic manipulation and research.

name: Wuji Hand 2
summary: Wuji Hand 2 is a five-finger, non-tactile robotic-hand prototype for research, robot integration and human-robot interaction. Its 20 independently actuated direct-drive joints support backdrivability, MIT force-position control and a 1 kHz control rate across 20 axes. The manufacturer provides Ethernet connectivity, SDK interfaces and simulation models. Passive protective skin must remain fitted during operation and does not provide tactile sensing. Specifications retain their documented Beta hardware configuration and measurement conditions.

name: X1
summary:
X1 is AgiBot's open humanoid development platform for research, education and experimentation with embodied intelligence. The robot uses a modular design intended to make hardware and software development more accessible. AgiBot lists a height of 130 cm, a mass of 33 kg and 31 degrees of freedom.

Its published walking and arm-load figures describe a lightweight experimental platform rather than a heavy-duty industrial handler. The open development approach supports work on robot motion, perception and control, with researchers able to build and evaluate their own applications. Demonstrations

name: X2
summary:
X2 is AgiBot's humanoid family for interactive services, demonstrations and movement development. It combines whole-body motion with visual, spoken and touch-based interaction, allowing gestures and expressions to accompany conversations or performances. The manufacturer describes different body configurations with approximately 25 to 30 degrees of freedom.

name: X2
summary: General-purpose servo-motor family with multi-turn absolute encoder options. The design emphasizes stable positioning and resistance to vibration and dust.

name: X6MN
summary: Miniature servo-motor family with multi-turn absolute feedback. The compact, low-inertia construction is intended for equipment with strict space constraints, including semiconductor machinery.

name: X7
summary: High-power servo-motor family for heavy-duty, high-torque applications. Absolute encoder options and an internal temperature sensor support machine integration.

name: X7 Pro
summary: X7 Pro is DAX Robotics’ wheeled humanoid platform for commercial mobile manipulation. It combines an expressive screen head, two articulated arms, configurable grippers or dexterous hands, and an omnidirectional mobile base. The manufacturer positions it for retail and logistics work, including pharmacy and parcel sorting. It supports teleoperation, software integration and local AI operation; the Pro configuration is promoted for commercial deployment. The exact delivery schedule remains unverified.

name: XCP-040
summary: An XC-family AC servo drive documented in Unisunbot’s official support manual. It uses a single-phase 220 V AC supply and supports position, speed and torque control modes, with an output-power range of 0.05–0.4 kW. Current availability is unverified.

name: XCP-075
summary: An XC-family AC servo drive documented in Unisunbot’s official support manual. It uses a single-phase 220 V AC supply and supports position, speed and torque control modes, with an output-power range of 0.75–1 kW. Current availability is unverified.

name: XHAND 1
summary: XHAND 1 is Robotera's five-finger hand designed for AI research and robotic manipulation. Its 12 active degrees of freedom are distributed as three each in the thumb and index finger and two in each remaining finger. Motors and gears provide independent joint control, including index-finger lateral movement. Optional high-resolution tactile sensors provide three-dimensional contact-force and temperature information. The official brochure lists a 1.1 kg mass, Linux SDK and ROS-compatible applications, together with glove and visual-mapping teleoperation support for testing and training-data col

name: Xialan S02 Humanoid Robot
summary:
Xialan S02 is Digit Robotics' humanlike interaction robot for reception, guided explanations and customer-facing communication. Its presentation emphasizes a lifelike face and coordinated speech, expression and gesture so that information can be delivered through a recognizable social character.

The manufacturer describes camera and microphone inputs for face tracking, sound localization and multi-turn dialogue, with mobile operation for configured indoor environments. Applications include exhibition interpretation, business inquiries and promotional engagement. Appearance and interaction con

name: Xiao Mo
summary:
Xiao Mo (小墨) is the name Spirit AI uses for its robot in a reported battery-production deployment at CATL's Zhongzhou site. The company describes the system as part of an embodied-intelligence production workflow, combining perception, decision-making and controlled physical execution for flexible manufacturing work.

name: Xiaochu
summary: Jingchu Xiaochu is a compact humanoid robot for teaching and cultural-tourism companionship. Its upper body has a head and two arms, while articulated wheel legs support movement, crouching, waving and dancing. The manufacturer describes binocular depth sensing for navigation and an AI voice module for conversation, with an optional gripper for simple tasks. It is officially listed as a product and was exhibited at WRC 2026; delivery terms are not verified.

name: Xiaoma 1
summary: Xiaoma 1 is a humanoid visitor-service robot developed through Jinma Matrix, Jinma’s controlled venture with Shanghai Matrix. It is intended for theme parks, scenic attractions and commercial complexes, with interactive and multilingual visitor assistance. The launch photograph shows a standing humanoid with two articulated arms and hands. Jinma publicly launched the model in November 2025; current commercial delivery status for this exact model has not been verified.

name: Xiaopu Simbot
summary: Xiaopu Simbot is Simple AI’s wheeled humanoid service robot for household and household-like commercial environments. Its upper body carries two articulated arms and a screen head above a mobile wheeled base. The manufacturer combines perception and manipulation hardware with task planning, memory and interaction software. At the 2026 World Robot Conference, it demonstrated audience interaction and household-style operations such as handling laundry and tidying. These demonstrations establish a physical platform; broad commercial delivery availability remains unverified.

name: Xiaotuo
summary:
Xiaotuo (小拓) is TOPSTAR's wheeled humanoid for industrial workflows, with a focus on translating embodied-intelligence research into production tasks. Its mobile, human-like manipulation arrangement is intended for handling and sorting work within manufacturing environments.

TOPSTAR's December 2025 account describes an application that autonomously sorts and arranges drone propeller blades, illustrating a specific injection-moulding-related workflow. The company emphasizes combining process knowledge, robot hardware, operational data and learned models. Demonstrated results for that workflow

name: XLJ001
summary: XLJ001 is the published patrol-robot controller PCBA configuration from Live Electronics. The manufacturer lists Wi-Fi/Bluetooth communication, automatic route planning and automatic charging. It is supplied within a custom board-development and integration offering; broad optional feature lists are not assumed to be the delivered configuration.

name: XMAN-R1
summary:
XMAN-R1 is KEENON's humanoid service robot for tasks requiring coordinated perception, manipulation and interaction with people. The company demonstrated it as a robotic barista at LEAP East 2026, carrying out a sequence that included handling a cup, operating the coffee-making workflow and delivering the finished drink after an order was placed on an iPad.

KEENON uses these demonstrations to illustrate multi-step task planning and controlled manipulation in commercial service settings. The examples establish the particular workflows shown; they do not by themselves establish unrestricted aut

name: XR1
summary: XR1 is a wheeled humanoid robot from Zhicheng AI for industrial material handling and repetitive work. It combines an omnidirectional mobile base, a vertical lift structure and two articulated arms with grippers. The manufacturer positions it for automotive parts, logistics and electronics production and describes hot-swappable batteries and integration with its AI models. Current commercial shipment availability is unverified.

name: Xynova Flex 2
summary: A biomimetic robotic hand with 23 degrees of freedom, multimodal sensing and mixed force-position control. The manufacturer distinguishes a 12 kg grasping load from a 4 kg rated continuous-operation load.

name: Yanshee
summary:
Yanshee is UBTECH's programmable humanoid for AI and robotics education. Its compact body combines a Raspberry Pi-based computing platform with articulated movement, visual and voice interaction, and connections for additional sensors. It is designed for students and researchers to link programming with physical experiments.

Developer resources support graphical programming, Python and other languages, with APIs for robot control and sensing. The platform can be used to explore image recognition, speech interaction, motion and environmental measurements. Capabilities depend on the installed s

name: Yin Yi NE01
summary: Yin Yi NE01 is GENISOM AI’s bipedal humanoid platform. It uses the company’s joint modules and motion-control technology in a compact humanlike body, with articulated arms and hands for interaction. The manufacturer positions NE01 for dynamic movement and embodied intelligence development, including research, performances and cultural or visitor-service applications. It has an official product page and public exhibition record; current delivery availability is unverified.

name: YITA-100P-C
summary: An integrated robot joint module in YITA Dynamics’ C series, combining precision transmission, drive control and dual absolute-encoder feedback. This model has a 44 N·m rated torque, 220 N·m peak torque and 1.1 kg mass. It supports EtherCAT and CAN FD and includes a through-bore for routing.

name: YITA-122P-C
summary: An integrated robot joint module in YITA Dynamics’ C series, combining precision transmission, drive control and dual absolute-encoder feedback. This model has a 62 N·m rated torque, 314 N·m peak torque and 1.6 kg mass. It supports EtherCAT and CAN FD and includes a through-bore for routing.

name: YITA-50P-C
summary: An integrated robot joint module in YITA Dynamics’ C series, combining precision transmission, drive control and dual absolute-encoder feedback. This model has a 2.2 N·m rated torque, 11 N·m peak torque and 0.3 kg mass. It supports EtherCAT and CAN FD and includes a through-bore for routing.

name: YITA-65P-C
summary: An integrated robot joint module in YITA Dynamics’ C series, combining precision transmission, drive control and dual absolute-encoder feedback. This model has a 7.8 N·m rated torque, 39 N·m peak torque and 0.5 kg mass. It supports EtherCAT and CAN FD and includes a through-bore for routing.

name: YITA-84P-C
summary: An integrated robot joint module in YITA Dynamics’ C series, combining precision transmission, drive control and dual absolute-encoder feedback. This model has a 12 N·m rated torque, 60 N·m peak torque and 0.7 kg mass. It supports EtherCAT and CAN FD and includes a through-bore for routing.

name: Yobot R2V2
summary: Yobot R2V2 is Openmind Robotics’ bipedal humanoid platform for physical work. It combines whole-body movement and manipulation with visual perception and the company’s robot software platform. An official demonstration showed R2V2 opening a carton, grasping water bottles and placing them on retail shelves. The model was introduced in the 2026 Yobot family; current ordering and delivery availability are unverified.

name: Yuanyou
summary: Yuanyou is HandX Innovation’s wheeled humanoid robot for everyday assistance and industrial support. It combines a mobile base, humanlike upper body, dexterous hands and multiple sensing modules. The manufacturer lists fine grasping, moxibustion-related actions and daily assistance among intended tasks. Product imagery and the corporate manual verify the named platform, while general availability and deployment scale remain unverified.

name: Z01
summary: Z01 is a bipedal humanoid developed within Zoomlion’s Zhongke Yungu robotics business. The company demonstrated wire-handling and sorting skills learned through imitation, alongside visitor interaction, greeting and guided tours. The robot is part of a wider portfolio sharing the group’s embodied intelligence software and industrial development environments. Public demonstrations establish the product, while general commercial availability has not been verified.

name: ZERITH Z1
summary:
ZERITH Z1 is the company's humanoid platform for research, education and exploration of physical-service applications. Its design combines human-like structure with movement control and AI-oriented development resources, with industrial, commercial and home assistance presented as potential application areas.

The manufacturer describes low-level interfaces, manipulation examples, learning-algorithm examples and data resources for customized development. This makes Z1 a platform that users can extend for specific tasks. Its bipedal configuration is distinct from the wheeled-arm H1, and task pe

name: ZERITH-H1
summary:
ZERITH H1 is a wheeled-arm robot designed for mobile manipulation, commercial services, household assistance and data collection. Its articulated body combines movement through a workspace with arms intended to reach and handle objects at different heights.

ZERITH's official presentation lists 19 degrees of freedom and a stated body reach extending from ground level to 2.20 metres. Those figures describe the manufacturer's configuration. H1 should be distinguished from Z1, the company's bipedal humanoid, when comparing mobility, control requirements and application suitability.

name: Zhishu 2
summary: Zhishu 2 is Guohua Intelligent's wheeled humanoid robot platform for indoor, level-floor environments. Its human-shaped upper body combines two articulated arms and dexterous hands with a height-adjustable column and wheeled base. The manufacturer positions it as an integrated mobile manipulation platform, with hardware for speech interaction, depth sensing, lidar mapping and arm control. It is offered as a configurable robot body and development platform; customer motion-control deployment and application integration are part of the intended use. The model has been publicly announced and exhi

name: ZWBMD016016
summary: MD-version miniature planetary gearbox with a 16 mm diameter. The official page lists reduction-stage and bearing configurations for compact drive assemblies.

name: ZWBPD016016
summary: PD-version miniature planetary gearbox with a 16 mm diameter. The official page lists reduction-stage and bearing configurations for compact drive assemblies.

name: ZWHAND
summary: ZWHAND is ZHAOWEI's bionic dexterous-hand family for robotic end-effector integration. The manufacturer's presentation combines independent finger-joint motors with fingertip sensing, drawing on its micro-motor, gearbox, encoder and control technologies. It describes 17- or 20-degree-of-freedom configurations for complex grasping, with potential use in humanoids and industrial automation. Because the public presentation covers multiple configurations, a single mass, load rating or joint arrangement is not assigned to the whole family. name: ZWLC012010-01
summary: Compact linear actuator identified by ZHAOWEI for palm mechanisms in dexterous hands. This is the -01 configuration of the 12 mm palm actuator.

name: ZWLC012010-02
summary: Compact linear actuator identified by ZHAOWEI for palm mechanisms in dexterous hands. This is the -02 configuration of the 12 mm palm actuator.

name: ZWLC014005-01
summary: Compact finger-joint actuator for dexterous-hand mechanisms. ZHAOWEI specifies linear travel and thrust for this model, despite the motor terminology in the product title.

name: ZWLP012010-01
summary: Parallel-layout linear actuator for thumb mechanisms in dexterous hands. ZHAOWEI provides model-specific travel, speed, current and thrust data.

name: ZWSMD008008
summary: SMD-series miniature planetary gearbox with an 8 mm diameter. The official page provides stage-dependent reduction and mechanical data for compact drive assemblies.
